हेमशृङ्गी शफै रौप्यैः सुशीला वस्त्रसंयुता /
सकांस्यपात्रा दातव्या क्षीरिणी गौः सदक्षिणा //
text_mt:
A milch-cow having horns of gold, hooves of silver, of good disposition, draped with cloth,
accompanied by a bell-metal vessel and a sacrificial fee, should be given.

sanskrit_iast:
dātāsyāḥ svargam āpnoti vatsarān romasammitān /
kapilā cet tārayati bhūyaś cāsaptamaṃ kulam //
meaning:
दातास्याः स्वर्गम् आप्नोति वत्सरान् रोमसम्मितान् /
कपिला चेत् तारयति भूयश् चासप्तमं कुलम् //
text_mt:
The giver of this [cow] attains heaven for as many years as there are hairs [on her];
if she is a tawny cow, she delivers her family even up to the seventh generation.

sanskrit_iast:
savatsāromatulyāni yugāny ubhayatomukhīm /
dātāsyāḥ svargam āpnoti pūrveṇa vidhinā dadat //
meaning:
सवत्सारोमतुल्यानि युगान्य् उभयतोमुखीम् /
दातास्याः स्वर्गम् आप्नोति पूर्वेण विधिना ददत् //
text_mt:
Giving a cow facing both ways according to the aforesaid rule,
her giver attains heaven for as many ages as there are hairs on her and the calf.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvad vatsasya pādau dvau mukhaṃ yonyāṃ ca dṛśyate /
tāvad gauḥ pṛthivī jñeyā yāvad garbhaṃ na muñcati //
meaning:
यावद् वत्सस्य पादौ द्वौ मुखं योन्यां च दृश्यते /
तावद् गौः पृथिवी ज्ञेया यावद् गर्भं न मुञ्चति //
text_mt:
As long as the two feet and the face of the calf are seen in the womb,
so long is the cow to be recognized as the earth, until she releases the embryo.

sanskrit_iast:
yathākathaṃcid dattvā gāṃ dhenuṃ vādhenum eva vā /
arogām aparikliṣṭāṃ dātā svarge mahīyate //
meaning:
यथाकथंचिद् दत्त्वा गां धेनुं वाधेनुम् एव वा /
अरोगाम् अपरिक्लिष्टां दाता स्वर्गे महीयते //
text_mt:
Having given a cow in any manner whatsoever, whether a milch-cow or not a milch-cow,
provided she is free from disease and not distressed, the giver is magnified in heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāntasaṃvāhanaṃ rogiparicaryā surārcanam /
pādaśaucaṃ dvijocchiṣṭamārjanaṃ gopradānavat //
meaning:
श्रान्तसंवाहनं रोगिपरिचर्या सुरार्चनम् /
पादशौचं द्विजोच्छिष्टमार्जनं गोप्रदानवत् //
text_mt:
Massaging the weary, attendance on the sick, worship of the gods,
washing the feet [of guests], and clearing the food-remnants of twice-born men are equal to the gift of a cow.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūdīpāṃś cānnavastrāmbhastilasarpiḥpratiśrayān /
naiveśikaṃ svarṇadhuryaṃ dattvā svarge mahīyate //
meaning:
भूदीपांश् चान्नवस्त्राम्भस्तिलसर्पिःप्रतिश्रयान् /
नैवेशिकं स्वर्णधुर्यं दत्त्वा स्वर्गे महीयते //
text_mt:
Having given land, lamps, food, clothing, water, sesame, clarified butter, shelters,
marriage expenses, gold, and a draft-ox, one is magnified in heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhadhānyābhayopānacchatramālyānulepanam /
yānaṃ vṛkṣaṃ priyaṃ śayyāṃ dattvātyantaṃ sukhī bhavet //
meaning:
गृहधान्याभयोपानच्छत्रमाल्यानुलेपनम् /
यानं वृक्षं प्रियं शय्यां दत्त्वात्यन्तं सुखी भवेत् //
text_mt:
Having given a house, grain, safety, shoes, an umbrella, garlands, ointment,
a conveyance, a tree, a desirable object, or a bed, one will become exceedingly happy.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadharmamayaṃ brahma pradānebhyo 'dhikaṃ yataḥ /
tad dadat samavāpnoti brahmalokam avicyutam //
meaning:
सर्वधर्ममयं ब्रह्म प्रदानेभ्यो ऽधिकं यतः /
तद् ददत् समवाप्नोति ब्रह्मलोकम् अविच्युतम् //
text_mt:
Because the Veda comprises all duties and is superior to gifts,
one who imparts it completely attains the imperishable world of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
pratigrahasamartho 'pi nādatte yaḥ pratigraham /
ye lokā dānaśīlānāṃ sa tān āpnoti puṣkalān //
meaning:
प्रतिग्रहसमर्थो ऽपि नादत्ते यः प्रतिग्रहम् /
ये लोका दानशीलानां स तान् आप्नोति पुष्कलान् //
text_mt:
He who, though capable of accepting gifts, does not take a gift,
attains those abundant worlds belonging to those of generous nature.

sanskrit_iast:
kuśāḥ śākaṃ payo matsyā gandhāḥ puṣpaṃ dadhi kṣitiḥ /
māṃsaṃ śayyāsanaṃ dhānāḥ pratyākheyaṃ na vāri ca //
meaning:
कुशाः शाकं पयो मत्स्या गन्धाः पुष्पं दधि क्षितिः /
मांसं शय्यासनं धानाः प्रत्याखेयं न वारि च //
text_mt:
Kuśa grass, vegetables, milk, fish, perfumes, flowers, curd, land,
meat, a bed, a seat, roasted grains, and water must not be refused.

sanskrit_iast:
ayācitāhṛtaṃ grāhyam api duṣkṛtakarmaṇaḥ /
anyatra kulaṭāṣaṇḍhapatitebhyas tathā dviṣaḥ //
meaning:
अयाचिताहृतं ग्राह्यम् अपि दुष्कृतकर्मणः /
अन्यत्र कुलटाषण्ढपतितेभ्यस् तथा द्विषः //
text_mt:
What is brought unasked should be accepted, even from an evildoer,
except from an unchaste woman, a eunuch, outcastes, and an enemy.

sanskrit_iast:
devātithiarcanakṛte gurubhṛtyārtham eva vā /
sarvataḥ pratigṛhṇīyād ātmavṛttyartham eva ca //
meaning:
देवातिथिअर्चनकृते गुरुभृत्यार्थम् एव वा /
सर्वतः प्रतिगृह्णीयाद् आत्मवृत्त्यर्थम् एव च //
text_mt:
For the sake of worshipping gods and guests, or for a guru and servants,
or for the sake of one's own livelihood, one may accept [gifts] from anyone.

sanskrit_iast:
amāvāsyāṣṭakā vṛddhiḥ kṛṣṇapakṣo 'yanadvayam /
dravyaṃ brāhmaṇasaṃpattir viṣuvat sūryasaṃkramaḥ //
meaning:
अमावास्याष्टका वृद्धिः कृष्णपक्षो ऽयनद्वयम् /
द्रव्यं ब्राह्मणसंपत्तिर् विषुवत् सूर्यसंक्रमः //
text_mt:
The new-moon day, the Aṣṭakā days, the increase of prosperity, the dark fortnight, the two solstices,
[the availability of] material, the presence of [worthy] Brahmins, the equinox, the sun's transit,

sanskrit_iast:
vyatīpāto gajacchāyā grahaṇaṃ candrasūryayoḥ /
śrāddhaṃ prati ruciś caite śrāddhakālāḥ prakīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
व्यतीपातो गजच्छाया ग्रहणं चन्द्रसूर्ययोः /
श्राद्धं प्रति रुचिश् चैते श्राद्धकालाः प्रकीर्तिताः //
text_mt:
the Vyatīpāta conjunction, the shadow of an elephant, eclipses of the moon and the sun,
and the desire for an ancestral rite—these are proclaimed the times for an ancestral rite.

sanskrit_iast:
agryaḥ sarveṣu vedeṣu śrotriyo brahmavid yuvā /
vedārthavij jyeṣṭhasāmā trimadhus trisuparṇakaḥ //
meaning:
अग्र्यः सर्वेषु वेदेषु श्रोत्रियो ब्रह्मविद् युवा /
वेदार्थविज् ज्येष्ठसामा त्रिमधुस् त्रिसुपर्णकः //
text_mt:
Foremost in all the Vedas, a learned Brahmin, a knower of Brahman, a youth,
a knower of the meaning of the Veda, a singer of the Jyeṣṭhasāman, a Trimadhu, a Trisuparṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
svasrīyartvijjāmātṛyājyaśvaśuramātulāḥ /
triṇāciketadauhitraśiṣyasaṃbandhibāndhavāḥ //
meaning:
स्वस्रीयर्त्विज्जामातृयाज्यश्वशुरमातुलाः /
त्रिणाचिकेतदौहित्रशिष्यसंबन्धिबान्धवाः //
text_mt:
a sister's son, a sacrificial priest, a son-in-law, a patron of sacrifice, a father-in-law, a maternal uncle,
a Triṇāciketa, a daughter's son, a student, a relative by marriage, and a kinsman,

sanskrit_iast:
karmaniṣṭhās taponiṣṭhāḥ pañcāgnir brahmacāriṇaḥ /
pitṛmātṛparāś caiva brāhmaṇāḥ śrāddhasaṃpadaḥ //
meaning:
कर्मनिष्ठास् तपोनिष्ठाः पञ्चाग्निर् ब्रह्मचारिणः /
पितृमातृपराश् चैव ब्राह्मणाः श्राद्धसंपदः //
text_mt:
those steadfast in rites, those steadfast in austerity, those keeping the five fires, chaste students,
and those devoted to father and mother—such Brahmins are the assets of an ancestral rite.

sanskrit_iast:
rogī hīnātiriktāṅgaḥ kāṇaḥ paunarbhavas tathā /
avakīrṇī kuṇḍagolau kunakhī śyāvadantakaḥ //
meaning:
रोगी हीनातिरिक्ताङ्गः काणः पौनर्भवस् तथा /
अवकीर्णी कुण्डगोलौ कुनखी श्यावदन्तकः //
text_mt:
A diseased man, one with deficient or redundant limbs, a one-eyed man, the son of a remarried woman,
one who has broken his vow of chastity, a Kuṇḍa, a Gola, one with deformed nails, one with discoloured teeth,

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛtakādhyāpakaḥ klībaḥ kanyādūṣy abhiśastakaḥ /
mitradhruk piśunaḥ somavikrayī parivindakaḥ //
meaning:
भृतकाध्यापकः क्लीबः कन्यादूष्य् अभिशस्तकः /
मित्रध्रुक् पिशुनः सोमविक्रयी परिविन्दकः //
text_mt:
a paid teacher, a eunuch, a defiler of maidens, one accused of a crime,
a betrayer of friends, a slanderer, a seller of soma, a younger brother married before the elder,

sanskrit_iast:
mātāpitṛgurutyāgī kuṇḍāśī vṛṣalātmajaḥ /
parapūrvāpatiḥ stenaḥ karmaduṣṭāś ca ninditāḥ //
meaning:
मातापितृगुरुत्यागी कुण्डाशी वृषलात्मजः /
परपूर्वापतिः स्तेनः कर्मदुष्टाश् च निन्दिताः //
text_mt:
one who has abandoned mother, father, or guru, an eater of food given by a Kuṇḍa, the son of a Shudra woman,
the husband of a woman married before, a thief, and those depraved in action are condemned.

sanskrit_iast:
nimantrayeta pūrvedyur brāhmaṇān ātmavān śuciḥ /
taiś cāpi saṃyatair bhāvyaṃ manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ //
meaning:
निमन्त्रयेत पूर्वेद्युर् ब्राह्मणान् आत्मवान् शुचिः /
तैश् चापि संयतैर् भाव्यं मनोवाक्कायकर्मभिः //
text_mt:
The self-restrained and pure [host] should invite Brahmins on the previous day;
and they too must be restrained in the actions of mind, speech, and body.

sanskrit_iast:
aparāhṇe samabhyarcya svāgatenāgatāṃs tu tān /
pavitrapāṇir ācāntān āsaneṣūpaveśayet //
meaning:
अपराह्णे समभ्यर्च्य स्वागतेनागतांस् तु तान् /
पवित्रपाणिर् आचान्तान् आसनेषूपवेशयेत् //
text_mt:
In the afternoon, having honoured them who have arrived with a welcome,
he, holding purificatory grass in hand, should seat them on seats after they have sipped water for purification,

sanskrit_iast:
yugmān daive yathāśakti pitrye 'yugmāṃs tathaiva ca /
paristṛte śucau deśe dakṣiṇāpravaṇe tathā //
meaning:
युग्मान् दैवे यथाशक्ति पित्र्ये ऽयुग्मांस् तथैव च /
परिस्तृते शुचौ देशे दक्षिणाप्रवणे तथा //
text_mt:
an even number for the divine [ancestral rite] according to his capacity, and an odd number for that of the ancestors,
in an enclosed, pure place that slopes to the south.

sanskrit_iast:
dvau daive prāk trayaḥ pitrya udag ekaikam eva vā /
mātāmahānām apy evaṃ tantraṃ vā vaiśvadevikam //
meaning:
द्वौ दैवे प्राक् त्रयः पित्र्य उदग् एकैकम् एव वा /
मातामहानाम् अप्य् एवं तन्त्रं वा वैश्वदेविकम् //
text_mt:
Two [Brahmins] facing east for the divine, three facing north for the ancestors, or even one for each;
so too for the maternal grandfathers, or a combined rite for the All-gods.

sanskrit_iast:
pāṇiprakṣālanaṃ dattvā viṣṭarārthaṃ kuśān api /
āvāhayed anujñāto viśve devāsa ity ṛcā //
meaning:
पाणिप्रक्षालनं दत्त्वा विष्टरार्थं कुशान् अपि /
आवाहयेद् अनुज्ञातो विश्वे देवास इत्य् ऋचा //
text_mt:
Having given water for washing the hands and kuśa grass for the purpose of a seat,
he should invoke [the deities], being permitted, with the verse: 'O All-gods...'

sanskrit_iast:
yavair anvavakīryātha bhājane sapavitrake /
śaṃ no devyā payaḥ kṣiptvā yavo 'sīti yavāṃs tathā //
meaning:
यवैर् अन्ववकीर्याथ भाजने सपवित्रके /
शं नो देव्या पयः क्षिप्त्वा यवो ऽसीति यवांस् तथा //
text_mt:
Then, having scattered barley grains over them, having poured water into a vessel containing a purifier with 'May the goddess be auspicious for us...',
and barley grains with 'You are barley...',

sanskrit_iast:
yā divyā iti mantreṇa hasteṣv arghyaṃ vinikṣipet /
dattvā udakaṃ gandhamālyaṃ dhūpadānaṃ sadīpakam //
meaning:
या दिव्या इति मन्त्रेण हस्तेष्व् अर्घ्यं विनिक्षिपेत् /
दत्त्वा उदकं गन्धमाल्यं धूपदानं सदीपकम् //
text_mt:
he should pour the guest-water into their hands with the mantra: 'The divine waters...'.
Having given water, perfumes, a garland, and an offering of incense accompanied by a lamp,

sanskrit_iast:
tathācchādanadānaṃ ca karaśaucārtham ambu ca /
apasavyaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pitṝṇām apradakṣiṇam //
meaning:
तथाच्छादनदानं च करशौचार्थम् अम्बु च /
अपसव्यं ततः कृत्वा पितॄणाम् अप्रदक्षिणम् //
text_mt:
and likewise an offering of clothing and water for cleansing the hands,
he should then place the sacred thread over the right shoulder, moving counter-clockwise for the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
dviguṇāṃs tu kuśān dattvā hy uṣantas tvety ṛcā pitṝn /
āvāhya tadanujñāto japed āyantu nas tataḥ //
meaning:
द्विगुणांस् तु कुशान् दत्त्वा ह्य् उषन्तस् त्वेत्य् ऋचा पितॄन् /
आवाह्य तदनुज्ञातो जपेद् आयन्तु नस् ततः //
text_mt:
Having offered doubled kuśa grass, having invoked the ancestors with the verse 'uśantas tvā',
and permitted by them, he should then chant 'āyantu naḥ'.

sanskrit_iast:
apahatā iti tilān vikīrya ca samantataḥ /
yavārthās tu tilaiḥ kāryāḥ kuryād arghyādi pūrvavat //
meaning:
अपहता इति तिलान् विकीर्य च समन्ततः /
यवार्थास् तु तिलैः कार्याः कुर्याद् अर्घ्यादि पूर्ववत् //
text_mt:
Scattering sesame seeds all around with the mantra 'apahatāḥ',
the purposes served by barley should be performed with sesame seeds; he should perform the guest-water and other rites as before.

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā arghyaṃ saṃsravāṃs teṣāṃ pātre kṛtvā vidhānataḥ /
pitṛbhyaḥ sthānam asīti nyubjaṃ pātraṃ karoty adhaḥ //
meaning:
दत्त्वा अर्घ्यं संस्रवांस् तेषां पात्रे कृत्वा विधानतः /
पितृभ्यः स्थानम् असीति न्युब्जं पात्रं करोत्य् अधः //
text_mt:
Having offered the guest-water and placed their washings into a vessel according to rule,
he turns the vessel upside down below, saying: 'You are a dwelling place for the ancestors.'

sanskrit_iast:
agnau kariṣyann ādāya pṛcchaty annaṃ ghṛtaplutam /
kuruṣvety abhyanujñāto hutvāgnau pitṛyajñavat //
meaning:
अग्नौ करिष्यन्न् आदाय पृच्छत्य् अन्नं घृतप्लुतम् /
कुरुष्वेत्य् अभ्यनुज्ञातो हुत्वाग्नौ पितृयज्ञवत् //
text_mt:
Intending to make offerings into the fire, he takes up food drenched in clarified butter and asks [the Brahmins]: 'May I make the offering in the fire?'
Permitted with 'Perform it!', having offered into the fire as in the ancestral sacrifice,

sanskrit_iast:
hutaśeṣaṃ pradadyāt tu bhājaneṣu samāhitaḥ /
yathālābhopapanneṣu raupyeṣu ca viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
हुतशेषं प्रदद्यात् तु भाजनेषु समाहितः /
यथालाभोपपन्नेषु रौप्येषु च विशेषतः //
text_mt:
collected in mind, he should distribute what remains of the oblation into vessels
obtained according to one's means, and especially into silver ones.

sanskrit_iast:
dattvānnaṃ pṛthivīpātram iti pātrābhimantraṇam /
kṛtvedaṃ viṣṇur ity anne dvijāṅguṣṭhaṃ niveśayet //
meaning:
दत्त्वान्नं पृथिवीपात्रम् इति पात्राभिमन्त्रणम् /
कृत्वेदं विष्णुर् इत्य् अन्ने द्विजाङ्गुष्ठं निवेशयेत् //
text_mt:
Having served the food and consecrated the vessels with the verse 'pṛthivī te pātram',
he should insert the Brahmin's thumb into the food with the formula 'idaṃ viṣṇuḥ'.

sanskrit_iast:
savyāhṛtikāṃ gāyatrīṃ madhu vātā iti tryṛcam /
japtvā yathāsukhaṃ vācyaṃ bhuñjīraṃs te 'pi vāgyatāḥ //
meaning:
सव्याहृतिकां गायत्रीं मधु वाता इति त्र्यृचम् /
जप्त्वा यथासुखं वाच्यं भुञ्जीरंस् ते ऽपि वाग्यताः //
text_mt:
Having chanted the Gāyatrī with its sacred utterances and the three verses beginning with 'madhu vātāḥ',
he should say: 'Eat at your ease'; and they, too, restrained in speech, should eat.

sanskrit_iast:
annam iṣtaṃ haviṣyaṃ ca dadyād akrodhano 'tvaraḥ /
ātṛptes tu pavitrāṇi japtvā pūrvajapaṃ tathā //
meaning:
अन्नम् इष्तं हविष्यं च दद्याद् अक्रोधनो ऽत्वरः /
आतृप्तेस् तु पवित्राणि जप्त्वा पूर्वजपं तथा //
text_mt:
Free from anger and without haste, he should serve food that is agreeable and fit for oblations,
chanting purifying texts until they are satisfied, as well as the previous chants.

sanskrit_iast:
annam ādāya tṛptāḥ stha śeṣaṃ caivānumānya ca /
tad annaṃ vikired bhūmau dadyāc cāpaḥ sakṛt sakṛt //
meaning:
अन्नम् आदाय तृप्ताः स्थ शेषं चैवानुमान्य च /
तद् अन्नं विकिरेद् भूमौ दद्याच् चापः सकृत् सकृत् //
text_mt:
Taking some food and asking: 'Are you satisfied?', and having received their assent for the remainder,
he should scatter that food on the ground and offer water once to each.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvam annam upādāya satilaṃ dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ /
ucchiṣṭasaṃnidhau piṇḍān dadyād vai pitṛyajñavat //
meaning:
सर्वम् अन्नम् उपादाय सतिलं दक्षिणामुखः /
उच्छिष्टसंनिधौ पिण्डान् दद्याद् वै पितृयज्ञवत् //
text_mt:
Taking all kinds of food mixed with sesame seeds, facing south,
he should place the balls of rice near the leftover food, just as in the ancestral sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
mātāmahānām apy evaṃ dadyād ācamanaṃ tataḥ /
svastivācyaṃ tataḥ kuryād akṣayyodakam eva ca //
meaning:
मातामहानाम् अप्य् एवं दद्याद् आचमनं ततः /
स्वस्तिवाच्यं ततः कुर्याद् अक्षय्योदकम् एव च //
text_mt:
In the same manner for maternal grandfathers, he should then give water for sipping;
then he should have blessings pronounced and offer inexhaustible water.

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā tu dakṣiṇāṃ śaktyā svadhākāram udāharet /
vācyatām ity anujñātaḥ prakṛtebhyaḥ svadhocyatām //
meaning:
दत्त्वा तु दक्षिणां शक्त्या स्वधाकारम् उदाहरेत् /
वाच्यताम् इत्य् अनुज्ञातः प्रकृतेभ्यः स्वधोच्यताम् //
text_mt:
Having given a sacrificial fee according to his means, he should utter the word svadhā;
permitted with the words 'Let it be pronounced!', he should say: 'May svadhā be spoken for those on whose behalf the rite is performed!'

sanskrit_iast:
brūyur astu svadhety ukte bhūmau siñcet tato jalam /
viśve devāś ca prīyantāṃ vipraiś cokta idaṃ japet //
meaning:
ब्रूयुर् अस्तु स्वधेत्य् उक्ते भूमौ सिञ्चेत् ततो जलम् /
विश्वे देवाश् च प्रीयन्तां विप्रैश् चोक्त इदं जपेत् //
text_mt:
They should say: 'Let there be svadhā.' When this is spoken, he should then sprinkle water on the ground;
and when the Brahmins say: 'May the Viśve Devas be pleased!', he should chant this:

sanskrit_iast:
dātāro no 'bhivardhantāṃ vedāḥ saṃtatir eva ca /
śraddhā ca no mā vyagamad bahu deyaṃ ca no 'stv iti //
meaning:
दातारो नो ऽभिवर्धन्तां वेदाः संततिर् एव च /
श्रद्धा च नो मा व्यगमद् बहु देयं च नो ऽस्त्व् इति //
text_mt:
'May donors increase for us, as also the Vedas and progeny;
may faith not depart from us, and may we have much to give!'

sanskrit_iast:
ity uktvoktvā priyā vācaḥ praṇipatya visarjayet /
vāje vāja iti prītaḥ pitṛpūrvaṃ visarjanam //
meaning:
इत्य् उक्त्वोक्त्वा प्रिया वाचः प्रणिपत्य विसर्जयेत् /
वाजे वाज इति प्रीतः पितृपूर्वं विसर्जनम् //
text_mt:
Having said this, having spoken kind words and prostrated himself, he should dismiss them;
pleased, with the verse 'vāje vāje', dismissal is made beginning with the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmiṃs tu saṃsravāḥ pūrvam arghyapātre niveśitāḥ /
pitṛpātraṃ taduttānaṃ kṛtvā viprān visarjayet //
meaning:
यस्मिंस् तु संस्रवाः पूर्वम् अर्घ्यपात्रे निवेशिताः /
पितृपात्रं तदुत्तानं कृत्वा विप्रान् विसर्जयेत् //
text_mt:
Turning upright that vessel of the ancestors
in which the washings had previously been placed in the guest-water vessel, he should dismiss the Brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
pradakṣiṇam anuvrajya bhuñjīta pitṛsevitam /
brahmacārī bhavet tāṃ tu rajanīṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ saha //
meaning:
प्रदक्षिणम् अनुव्रज्य भुञ्जीत पितृसेवितम् /
ब्रह्मचारी भवेत् तां तु रजनीं ब्राह्मणैः सह //
text_mt:
Having walked around clockwise and escorted them, he should eat what was enjoyed by the ancestors;
and along with the Brahmins, he should remain a celibate student for that night.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ pradakṣiṇāvṛtko vṛddhau nāndīmukhān pitṝn /
yajeta dadhi karkandhumiśrān piṇḍān yavaiḥ kriyāḥ //
meaning:
एवं प्रदक्षिणावृत्को वृद्धौ नान्दीमुखान् पितॄन् /
यजेत दधि कर्कन्धुमिश्रान् पिण्डान् यवैः क्रियाः //
text_mt:
In this manner, turning clockwise at a joyful celebration, he should worship the Nāndīmukha ancestors,
performing the rites with barley and offering rice-balls mixed with curds and jujube fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
ekoddiṣṭaṃ devahīnam ekārghyaikapavitrakam /
āvāhanāgnaukaraṇarahitaṃ hy apasavyavat //
meaning:
एकोद्दिष्टं देवहीनम् एकार्घ्यैकपवित्रकम् /
आवाहनाग्नौकरणरहितं ह्य् अपसव्यवत् //
text_mt:
The rite for a single ancestor is devoid of the gods, has a single guest-water offering and a single strainer,
is without the invocation and the offering into the fire, and is performed with the sacred thread over the right shoulder.

sanskrit_iast:
upatiṣṭhatām akṣayyasthāne vipravisarjane /
abhiramyatām iti vaded brūyus te 'bhiratāḥ sma ha //
meaning:
उपतिष्ठताम् अक्षय्यस्थाने विप्रविसर्जने /
अभिरम्यताम् इति वदेद् ब्रूयुस् ते ऽभिरताः स्म ह //
text_mt:
In place of 'May it be inexhaustible', he says 'May it attend [upon you]'; at the dismissal of the Brahmins,
he should say 'May you be pleased', and they should reply 'We are well pleased.'

sanskrit_iast:
gandhodakatilair yuktaṃ kuryāt pātracatuṣṭayam /
arghyārthaṃ pitṛpātreṣu pretapātraṃ prasecayet //
meaning:
गन्धोदकतिलैर् युक्तं कुर्यात् पात्रचतुष्टयम् /
अर्घ्यार्थं पितृपात्रेषु प्रेतपात्रं प्रसेचयेत् //
text_mt:
He should prepare four vessels supplied with scented water and sesame seeds
for the guest-water; into the ancestors' vessels he should pour the vessel of the deceased,

sanskrit_iast:
ye samānā iti dvābhyāṃ śeṣaṃ pūrvavad ācaret /
etat sapiṇḍīkaraṇam ekoddiṣṭaṃ striyā api //
meaning:
ये समाना इति द्वाभ्यां शेषं पूर्ववद् आचरेत् /
एतत् सपिण्डीकरणम् एकोद्दिष्टं स्त्रिया अपि //
text_mt:
with the two verses beginning with 'ye samānāḥ', and perform the rest as before.
This is the rite of union through ancestral cakes; a single-ancestor rite is also performed for a woman.

sanskrit_iast:
arvāksapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ yasya saṃvatsarād bhavet /
tasyāpy annaṃ sodakumbhaṃ dadyāt saṃvatsaraṃ dvije //
meaning:
अर्वाक्सपिण्डीकरणं यस्य संवत्सराद् भवेत् /
तस्याप्य् अन्नं सोदकुम्भं दद्यात् संवत्सरं द्विजे //
text_mt:
For someone whose rite of union through ancestral cakes occurs before a year has passed,
food accompanied by a water-jar should still be given to a Brahmin for a whole year.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛte 'hani prakartavyaṃ pratimāsaṃ tu vatsaram /
pratisaṃvatsaraṃ caivam ādyam ekādaśe 'hani //
meaning:
मृते ऽहनि प्रकर्तव्यं प्रतिमासं तु वत्सरम् /
प्रतिसंवत्सरं चैवम् आद्यम् एकादशे ऽहनि //
text_mt:
It should be performed on the day of death every month for a year,
and likewise every year; the first should be on the eleventh day.

sanskrit_iast:
piṇḍāṃs tu go'javiprebhyo dadyād agnau jale 'pi vā /
prakṣipet satsu vipreṣu dvijocchiṣṭaṃ na mārjayet //
meaning:
पिण्डांस् तु गोऽजविप्रेभ्यो दद्याद् अग्नौ जले ऽपि वा /
प्रक्षिपेत् सत्सु विप्रेषु द्विजोच्छिष्टं न मार्जयेत् //
text_mt:
He should give the balls of rice to cows, goats, and Brahmins, or cast them into fire or water;
while the Brahmins are present, he must not clear away the Brahmins' leftover food.

sanskrit_iast:
haviṣyānnena vai māsaṃ pāyasena tu vatsaram /
mātsyahāriṇakaurabhaśākunacchāgapārṣataiḥ //
meaning:
हविष्यान्नेन वै मासं पायसेन तु वत्सरम् /
मात्स्यहारिणकौरभशाकुनच्छागपार्षतैः //
text_mt:
With food fit for oblations, for a month; but with rice-milk, for a year;
with the meat of fish, deer, sheep, birds, goats, spotted deer,

sanskrit_iast:
aiṇarauravavārāhaśāśair māṃsair yathākramam /
māsavṛddhyābhitṛpyanti dattair iha pitāmahāḥ //
meaning:
ऐणरौरववाराहशाशैर् मांसैर् यथाक्रमम् /
मासवृद्ध्याभितृप्यन्ति दत्तैर् इह पितामहाः //
text_mt:
blackbuck, Ruru deer, wild boar, and hare in regular order,
with an increase of a month each time, the grandfathers are fully satisfied here by what is given.

sanskrit_iast:
khaḍdāmiṣaṃ mahāśalkaṃ madhu munyannam eva vā /
lauhāmiṣaṃ mahāśākaṃ māṃsaṃ vārdhrīṇasasya ca //
meaning:
खड्दामिषं महाशल्कं मधु मुन्यन्नम् एव वा /
लौहामिषं महाशाकं मांसं वार्ध्रीणसस्य च //
text_mt:
Rhinoceros meat, large-scaled fish, honey, hermit's food,
red-goat meat, the mahāśāka herb, or the meat of the old white-winged goat,

sanskrit_iast:
yad dadāti gayāsthaś ca sarvam ānantyam aśnute /
tathā varṣātrayodaśyāṃ maghāsu ca viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
यद् ददाति गयास्थश् च सर्वम् आनन्त्यम् अश्नुते /
तथा वर्षात्रयोदश्यां मघासु च विशेषतः //
text_mt:
and whatever one gives while staying in Gayā, all that attains endless duration;
and likewise on the thirteenth day of the rainy season, especially under the Maghā asterism.

sanskrit_iast:
kanyāṃ kanyāvedinaś ca paśūn vai satsutān api /
dyūtaṃ kṛṣiṃ vāṇijyāṃ ca dviśaphaikaśaphāṃs tathā //
meaning:
कन्यां कन्यावेदिनश् च पशून् वै सत्सुतान् अपि /
द्यूतं कृषिं वाणिज्यां च द्विशफैकशफांस् तथा //
text_mt:
One who gives the ancestral rite always obtains a maiden, and husbands for maidens, cattle and good sons,
gambling victory, agriculture, commerce, cloven-hoofed and single-hoofed beasts,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmavarcasvinaḥ putrān svarṇarūpye sakupyake /
jñātiśraiṣṭhyaṃ sarvakāmān āpnoti śrāddhadaḥ sadā //
meaning:
ब्रह्मवर्चस्विनः पुत्रान् स्वर्णरूप्ये सकुप्यके /
ज्ञातिश्रैष्ठ्यं सर्वकामान् आप्नोति श्राद्धदः सदा //
text_mt:
sons endowed with Vedic splendour, gold and silver along with base metals,
pre-eminence among kin, and all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
pratipatprabhṛtiṣv ekāṃ varjayitvā caturdaśīm /
śastreṇa tu hatā ye vai tebhyas tatra pradīyate //
meaning:
प्रतिपत्प्रभृतिष्व् एकां वर्जयित्वा चतुर्दशीम् /
शस्त्रेण तु हता ये वै तेभ्यस् तत्र प्रदीयते //
text_mt:
On the lunar days beginning with the first, with the exception of the fourteenth—
for on that day it is offered only to those who have been slain by weapons—

sanskrit_iast:
svargaṃ hy apatyam ojaś ca śauryaṃ kṣetraṃ balaṃ tathā /
putraṃ śraiṣṭhyaṃ ca saubhāgyaṃ samṛddhiṃ mukhyatāṃ śubham //
meaning:
स्वर्गं ह्य् अपत्यम् ओजश् च शौर्यं क्षेत्रं बलं तथा /
पुत्रं श्रैष्ठ्यं च सौभाग्यं समृद्धिं मुख्यतां शुभम् //
text_mt:
heaven, offspring, vigour, valour, land, strength,
a son, pre-eminence, good fortune, prosperity, leadership, good fortune,

sanskrit_iast:
pravṛttacakratāṃ caiva vāṇijyaprabhṛtīn api /
arogitvaṃ yaśo vītaśokatāṃ paramāṃ gatim //
meaning:
प्रवृत्तचक्रतां चैव वाणिज्यप्रभृतीन् अपि /
अरोगित्वं यशो वीतशोकतां परमां गतिम् //
text_mt:
unchallenged sovereignty, commerce and the like,
freedom from illness, fame, freedom from sorrow, the highest destination,

sanskrit_iast:
dhanaṃ vedān bhiṣaksiddhiṃ kupyaṃ gā apy ajāvikam /
aśvān āyuś ca vidhivad yaḥ śrāddhaṃ saṃprayacchati //
meaning:
धनं वेदान् भिषक्सिद्धिं कुप्यं गा अप्य् अजाविकम् /
अश्वान् आयुश् च विधिवद् यः श्राद्धं संप्रयच्छति //
text_mt:
wealth, the Vedas, success in medicine, base metals, cattle, goats, sheep,
horses, and long life—whoever offers the ancestral rite according to rule,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛttikādibharaṇyantaṃ sa kāmān āpnuyād imān /
āstikaḥ śraddadhānaś ca vyapetamadamatsaraḥ //
meaning:
कृत्तिकादिभरण्यन्तं स कामान् आप्नुयाद् इमान् /
आस्तिकः श्रद्दधानश् च व्यपेतमदमत्सरः //
text_mt:
from the lunar mansion Kṛttikā to Bharaṇī, shall obtain these desires,
provided he is an astika, full of faith, and free from pride and envy.

sanskrit_iast:
vasurudrāditisutāḥ pitaraḥ śrāddhadevatāḥ /
prīṇayanti manuṣyāṇāṃ pitṝn śrāddhena tarpitāḥ //
meaning:
वसुरुद्रादितिसुताः पितरः श्राद्धदेवताः /
प्रीणयन्ति मनुष्याणां पितॄन् श्राद्धेन तर्पिताः //
text_mt:
The ancestors are the Vasus, the Rudras, and the sons of Aditi; they are the deities of the ancestral rite;
satisfied by the ancestral rite, they bring gratification to the ancestors of human beings.

sanskrit_iast:
āyuḥ prajāṃ dhanaṃ vidyāṃ svargaṃ mokṣaṃ sukhāni ca /
prayacchanti tathā rājyaṃ prītā nṝṇāṃ pitāmahāḥ //
meaning:
आयुः प्रजां धनं विद्यां स्वर्गं मोक्षं सुखानि च /
प्रयच्छन्ति तथा राज्यं प्रीता नॄणां पितामहाः //
text_mt:
Long life, offspring, wealth, sacred knowledge, heaven, liberation, and pleasures,
and likewise sovereignty—the grandfathers, when pleased, bestow upon mortals.

sanskrit_iast:
vināyakaḥ karmavighnasiddhyarthaṃ viniyojitaḥ /
gaṇānām ādhipatye ca rudreṇa brahmaṇā tathā //
meaning:
विनायकः कर्मविघ्नसिद्ध्यर्थं विनियोजितः /
गणानाम् आधिपत्ये च रुद्रेण ब्रह्मणा तथा //
text_mt:
Vināyaka was appointed by Rudra and Brahmā
to bring about obstacles to actions, and to hold leadership over the gaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
tenopasṛṣṭo yas tasya lakṣaṇāni nibodhata /
svapne 'vagāhate 'tyarthaṃ jalaṃ muṇḍāṃś ca paśyati //
meaning:
तेनोपसृष्टो यस् तस्य लक्षणानि निबोधत /
स्वप्ने ऽवगाहते ऽत्यर्थं जलं मुण्डांश् च पश्यति //
text_mt:
Learn the marks of one who is possessed by him:
he plunges deeply into water in dreams, and sees shaven-headed men;

sanskrit_iast:
kāṣāyavāsasaś caiva kravyādāṃś cādhirohati /
antyajair gardabhair uṣṭraiḥ sahaikatrāvatiṣṭhate //
meaning:
काषायवाससश् चैव क्रव्यादांश् चाधिरोहति /
अन्त्यजैर् गर्दभैर् उष्ट्रैः सहैकत्रावतिष्ठते //
text_mt:
he sees people wearing ochre robes, and mounts carnivorous animals;
he stands together in one place with outcasts, donkeys, and camels;

sanskrit_iast:
vrajann api tathātmānaṃ manyate 'nugataṃ paraiḥ /
vimanā viphalārambhaḥ saṃsīdaty animittataḥ //
meaning:
व्रजन्न् अपि तथात्मानं मन्यते ऽनुगतं परैः /
विमना विफलारम्भः संसीदत्य् अनिमित्ततः //
text_mt:
even when walking, he imagines himself pursued by enemies;
he is despondent, his undertakings fail, and he falls into despair without cause.

sanskrit_iast:
tenopasṛṣṭo labhate na rājyaṃ rājanandanaḥ /
kumārī ca na bhartāram apatyaṃ garbham aṅganā //
meaning:
तेनोपसृष्टो लभते न राज्यं राजनन्दनः /
कुमारी च न भर्तारम् अपत्यं गर्भम् अङ्गना //
text_mt:
Possessed by him, a prince does not gain the kingdom,
a maiden does not obtain a husband, nor a woman offspring or conception;

sanskrit_iast:
ācāryatvaṃ śrotriyaś ca na śiṣyo 'dhyayanaṃ tathā /
vaṇiglābhaṃ na cāpnoti kṛṣiṃ cāpi kṛṣīvalaḥ //
meaning:
आचार्यत्वं श्रोत्रियश् च न शिष्यो ऽध्ययनं तथा /
वणिग्लाभं न चाप्नोति कृषिं चापि कृषीवलः //
text_mt:
a learned Brahmin does not attain the preceptor's status, nor a disciple his Vedic study;
a merchant does not gain profit, nor a ploughman agriculture.

sanskrit_iast:
snapanaṃ tasya kartavyaṃ puṇye 'hni vidhipūrvakam /
gaurasarṣapakalkena sājyenotsāditasya ca //
meaning:
स्नपनं तस्य कर्तव्यं पुण्ये ऽह्नि विधिपूर्वकम् /
गौरसर्षपकल्केन साज्येनोत्सादितस्य च //
text_mt:
For him a bath should be performed on an auspicious day according to rule,
after he has been rubbed with white mustard paste mixed with clarified butter,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāuṣadhaiḥ sarvagandhair viliptaśirasas tathā /
bhadrāsanopaviṣṭasya svastivācyā dvijāḥ śubhāḥ //
meaning:
सर्वाउषधैः सर्वगन्धैर् विलिप्तशिरसस् तथा /
भद्रासनोपविष्टस्य स्वस्तिवाच्या द्विजाः शुभाः //
text_mt:
and his head anointed with all medicinal herbs and all perfumes;
while he is seated on an auspicious seat, auspicious Brahmins should be made to pronounce blessings.

sanskrit_iast:
aśvasthānād gajasthānād valmīkāt saṃgamād hradāt /
mṛttikāṃ rocanāṃ gandhān gugguluṃ cāpsu nikṣipet //
meaning:
अश्वस्थानाद् गजस्थानाद् वल्मीकात् संगमाद् ह्रदात् /
मृत्तिकां रोचनां गन्धान् गुग्गुलुं चाप्सु निक्षिपेत् //
text_mt:
One should cast into the water earth from a stable, an elephant-stable, an anthill, a confluence, and a lake,
and [also] rocanā, perfumes, and bdellium.

sanskrit_iast:
yā āhṛtā hy ekavarṇaiś caturbhiḥ kalaśair hradāt /
carmaṇy ānaḍuhe rakte sthāpyaṃ bhadrāsanaṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
या आहृता ह्य् एकवर्णैश् चतुर्भिः कलशैर् ह्रदात् /
चर्मण्य् आनडुहे रक्ते स्थाप्यं भद्रासनं ततः //
text_mt:
Then, onto a red ox-hide, [water] brought from a lake
with four monochromatic jars should be poured, and the auspicious seat placed thereon.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrākṣaṃ śatadhāram ṛṣibhiḥ pāvanaṃ kṛtam /
tena tvām abhiṣiñcāmi pāvamānyaḥ punantu te //
meaning:
सहस्राक्षं शतधारम् ऋषिभिः पावनं कृतम् /
तेन त्वाम् अभिषिञ्चामि पावमान्यः पुनन्तु ते //
text_mt:
‘[The water] thousand-eyed, hundred-streamed, made purifying by the sages—
with that I sprinkle you; may the purifying verses purify you!’

sanskrit_iast:
bhagaṃ te varuṇo rājā bhagaṃ sūryo bṛhaspatiḥ /
bhagam indraś ca vāyuś ca bhagaṃ saptarṣayo daduḥ //
meaning:
भगं ते वरुणो राजा भगं सूर्यो बृहस्पतिः /
भगम् इन्द्रश् च वायुश् च भगं सप्तर्षयो ददुः //
text_mt:
‘May King Varuṇa give you fortune; fortune may the Sun [and] Bṛhaspati [give];
fortune may Indra and Vāyu, fortune may the Seven Sages give!’

sanskrit_iast:
yat te keśeṣu daurbhāgyaṃ sīmante yac ca mūrdhani /
lalāṭe karṇayor akṣṇor āpas tad ghnantu sarvadā //
meaning:
यत् ते केशेषु दौर्भाग्यं सीमन्ते यच् च मूर्धनि /
ललाटे कर्णयोर् अक्ष्णोर् आपस् तद् घ्नन्तु सर्वदा //
text_mt:
‘Whatever misfortune is in your hair, in the parting of your hair, and on your head,
on your forehead, your two ears, [and] your two eyes—may the waters always destroy that!’

sanskrit_iast:
snātasya sārṣapaṃ tailaṃ sruveṇaudumbareṇa tu /
juhuyān mūrdhani kuśān savyena parigṛhya ca //
meaning:
स्नातस्य सार्षपं तैलं स्रुवेणौदुम्बरेण तु /
जुहुयान् मूर्धनि कुशान् सव्येन परिगृह्य च //
text_mt:
For him who has bathed, holding kuśa grass with the left [hand],
one should offer mustard oil upon his head with an udumbara ladle,

sanskrit_iast:
mitaś ca sammitaś caiva tathā śālakaṭaṅkaṭau /
kūśmāṇḍo rājaputraś cety ante svāhāsamanvitaiḥ //
meaning:
मितश् च सम्मितश् चैव तथा शालकटङ्कटौ /
कूश्माण्डो राजपुत्रश् चेत्य् अन्ते स्वाहासमन्वितैः //
text_mt:
With the names ‘Mita’, ‘Sammita’, and likewise ‘Śālakaṭaṅkaṭa’,
and ‘Kūśmāṇḍarājaputra’, accompanied at the end by ‘svāhā’.

sanskrit_iast:
nāmabhir balimantraiś ca namaskārasamanvitaiḥ /
dadyāc catuṣpathe śūrpe kuśān āstīrya sarvataḥ //
meaning:
नामभिर् बलिमन्त्रैश् च नमस्कारसमन्वितैः /
दद्याच् चतुष्पथे शूर्पे कुशान् आस्तीर्य सर्वतः //
text_mt:
Having scattered kuśa grass all around in a winnowing basket at a crossroads,
one should offer [the oblations] with the names and the offering mantras accompanied by obeisance:

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtākṛtāṃs taṇḍulāṃś ca palalaudanam eva ca /
matsyān pakvāṃs tathaivāmān māṃsam etāvad eva tu //
meaning:
कृताकृतांस् तण्डुलांश् च पललौदनम् एव च /
मत्स्यान् पक्वांस् तथैवामान् मांसम् एतावद् एव तु //
text_mt:
Cooked and uncooked rice grains, and sesame-seed rice,
fish cooked and raw, and only just that much meat,

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpaṃ citraṃ sugandhaṃ ca surāṃ ca trividhām api /
mūlakaṃ pūrikāpūpāṃs tathaivoṇḍerakasrajaḥ //
meaning:
पुष्पं चित्रं सुगन्धं च सुरां च त्रिविधाम् अपि /
मूलकं पूरिकापूपांस् तथैवोण्डेरकस्रजः //
text_mt:
Variegated and fragrant flowers, and liquor of three kinds as well,
radish, pūrikā cakes, and likewise garlands of oṇḍeraka cakes,

sanskrit_iast:
dadhy annaṃ pāyasaṃ caiva guḍapiṣṭaṃ samodakam /
etān sarvān samāhṛtya bhūmau kṛtvā tataḥ śiraḥ //
meaning:
दध्य् अन्नं पायसं चैव गुडपिष्टं समोदकम् /
एतान् सर्वान् समाहृत्य भूमौ कृत्वा ततः शिरः //
text_mt:
Curd, boiled rice, rice-milk pudding, and jaggery-dough with water—
having brought together all these, and then placing his head on the ground,

sanskrit_iast:
vināyakasya jananīm upatiṣṭhet tato 'mbikām /
dūrvāsarṣapapuṣpāṇāṃ dattvārghyaṃ pūrṇam añjalim //
meaning:
विनायकस्य जननीम् उपतिष्ठेत् ततो ऽम्बिकाम् /
दूर्वासर्षपपुष्पाणां दत्त्वार्घ्यं पूर्णम् अञ्जलिम् //
text_mt:
One should then revere Ambikā, the mother of Vināyaka,
having offered a full palmful of dūrvā grass, mustard, and flowers as an arghya offering:

sanskrit_iast:
rūpaṃ dehi yaśo dehi bhagaṃ bhavati dehi me /
putrān dehi dhanaṃ dehi sarvakāmāṃś ca dehi me //
meaning:
रूपं देहि यशो देहि भगं भवति देहि मे /
पुत्रान् देहि धनं देहि सर्वकामांश् च देहि मे //
text_mt:
‘Give [me] beauty, give renown, give me fortune, O Lady!
Give sons, give wealth, and give me all desires!’

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ śuklāmbaradharaḥ śuklamālyānulepanaḥ /
brāhmaṇān bhojayed dadyād vastrayugmaṃ guror api //
meaning:
ततः शुक्लाम्बरधरः शुक्लमाल्यानुलेपनः /
ब्राह्मणान् भोजयेद् दद्याद् वस्त्रयुग्मं गुरोर् अपि //
text_mt:
Then, wearing white garments, with white garlands and ointments,
he should feed Brahmins and give a pair of garments even to his guru.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ vināyakaṃ pūjya grahāṃś caiva vidhānataḥ /
karmaṇāṃ phalam āpnoti śriyaṃ cāpnoty anuttamām //
meaning:
एवं विनायकं पूज्य ग्रहांश् चैव विधानतः /
कर्मणां फलम् आप्नोति श्रियं चाप्नोत्य् अनुत्तमाम् //
text_mt:
Having thus worshipped Vināyaka and the planets according to the rule,
he attains the fruit of his undertakings and attains unsurpassed prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
ādityasya sadā pūjāṃ tilakaṃ svāminas tathā /
mahāgaṇapateś caiva kurvan siddhim avāpnuyāt //
meaning:
आदित्यस्य सदा पूजां तिलकं स्वामिनस् तथा /
महागणपतेश् चैव कुर्वन् सिद्धिम् अवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt:
Always performing worship of the Sun, and an auspicious forehead-mark, and [worship] of the Lord,
and of Mahāgaṇapati, one would attain success.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkāmaḥ śāntikāmo vā grahayajñaṃ samācaret /
vṛṣṭyāyuḥpuṣṭikāmo vā tathaivābhicarann api //
meaning:
श्रीकामः शान्तिकामो वा ग्रहयज्ञं समाचरेत् /
वृष्ट्यायुःपुष्टिकामो वा तथैवाभिचरन्न् अपि //
text_mt:
One who desires prosperity, or one who desires pacification, should perform a sacrifice to the planets,
or one who desires rain, longevity, or nourishment, or even one performing an incantation.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryaḥ somo mahīputraḥ somaputro bṛhaspatiḥ /
śukraḥ śanaiścaro rāhuḥ ketuś ceti grahāḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
सूर्यः सोमो महीपुत्रः सोमपुत्रो बृहस्पतिः /
शुक्रः शनैश्चरो राहुः केतुश् चेति ग्रहाः स्मृताः //
text_mt:
The Sun, the Moon, the Son of the Earth, the Son of the Moon, Bṛhaspati,
Venus, Saturn, Rāhu, and Ketu—these are known as the planets.

sanskrit_iast:
tāmrakāt sphaṭikād raktacandanāt svarṇakād ubhau /
rājatād ayasaḥ sīsāt kāṃsyāt kāryā grahāḥ kramāt //
meaning:
ताम्रकात् स्फटिकाद् रक्तचन्दनात् स्वर्णकाद् उभौ /
राजताद् अयसः सीसात् कांस्यात् कार्या ग्रहाः क्रमात् //
text_mt:
From copper, crystal, red sandalwood, gold—both [the next two]—,
silver, iron, lead, and bronze, the planets should be made in order;

sanskrit_iast:
svavarṇair vā paṭe lekhyā gandhair maṇḍalakeṣu vā /
yathāvarṇaṃ pradeyāni vāsāṃsi kusumāni ca //
meaning:
स्ववर्णैर् वा पटे लेख्या गन्धैर् मण्डलकेषु वा /
यथावर्णं प्रदेयानि वासांसि कुसुमानि च //
text_mt:
Or they should be drawn on cloth with their respective colours, or with perfumes in circular diagrams;
clothing and flowers are to be given corresponding to their colours,

sanskrit_iast:
gandhāś ca balayaś caiva dhūpo deyaś ca gugguluḥ /
kartavyā mantravantaś ca caravaḥ pratidaivatam //
meaning:
गन्धाश् च बलयश् चैव धूपो देयश् च गुग्गुलुः /
कर्तव्या मन्त्रवन्तश् च चरवः प्रतिदैवतम् //
text_mt:
And perfumes, offerings, incense, and bdellium are to be given;
and sacrificial porridge endowed with mantras is to be prepared for each deity.

sanskrit_iast:
ākṛṣṇena imaṃ devā agnir mūrdhā divaḥ kakut /
udbudhyasveti ca ṛco yathāsaṃkhyaṃ prakīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
आकृष्णेन इमं देवा अग्निर् मूर्धा दिवः ककुत् /
उद्बुध्यस्वेति च ऋचो यथासंख्यं प्रकीर्तिताः //
text_mt:
‘Ā kṛṣṇena’, ‘Imaṃ devāḥ’, ‘Agnir mūrdhā divaḥ kakut’,
and ‘Udbudhyasva’ are proclaimed as the verses in respective order;

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspate 'ti yad aryas tathaivānnāt parisrutaḥ /
śaṃ no devīs tathā kāṇḍāt ketuṃ kṛṇvann imāṃs tathā //
meaning:
बृहस्पते ऽति यद् अर्यस् तथैवान्नात् परिस्रुतः /
शं नो देवीस् तथा काण्डात् केतुं कृण्वन्न् इमांस् तथा //
text_mt:
‘Bṛhaspate ati yad aryaḥ’, and likewise ‘Annāt parisrutaḥ’,
‘Śaṃ no devīḥ’, and ‘Kāṇḍāt’, and then ‘Ketuṃ kṛṇvan’—these [verses].

sanskrit_iast:
arkaḥ palāśaḥ khadira apāmārgo 'tha pippalaḥ /
udumbaraḥ śamī dūrvā kuśāś ca samidhaḥ kramāt //
meaning:
अर्कः पलाशः खदिर अपामार्गो ऽथ पिप्पलः /
उदुम्बरः शमी दूर्वा कुशाश् च समिधः क्रमात् //
text_mt:
Arka, palāśa, khadira, and apāmārga, then pippala,
udumbara, śamī, dūrvā, and kuśa are the firewood sticks in order.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikasya tv aṣṭaśatam aṣṭāviṃśatir eva vā /
hotavyā madhusarpirbhyāṃ dadhnā kṣīreṇa vā yutāḥ //
meaning:
एकैकस्य त्व् अष्टशतम् अष्टाविंशतिर् एव वा /
होतव्या मधुसर्पिर्भ्यां दध्ना क्षीरेण वा युताः //
text_mt:
For each one, one hundred and eight, or indeed twenty-eight,
should be offered, mixed with honey and clarified butter, or curd, or milk.

sanskrit_iast:
guḍaudanaṃ pāyasaṃ ca haviṣyaṃ kṣīraṣāṣṭikam /
dadhyodanaṃ haviś cūrṇaṃ māṃsaṃ citrānnam eva ca //
meaning:
गुडौदनं पायसं च हविष्यं क्षीरषाष्टिकम् /
दध्योदनं हविश् चूर्णं मांसं चित्रान्नम् एव च //
text_mt:
Jaggery-rice, rice-milk pudding, sacrificial food, milk rice from sixty-day grain,
curd-rice, clarified butter, meal, meat, and variegated food—

sanskrit_iast:
dadyād grahakramād evaṃ dvijebhyo bhojanaṃ budhaḥ /
śaktito vā yathālābhaṃ satkṛtya vidhipūrvakam //
meaning:
दद्याद् ग्रहक्रमाद् एवं द्विजेभ्यो भोजनं बुधः /
शक्तितो वा यथालाभं सत्कृत्य विधिपूर्वकम् //
text_mt:
A wise man should thus give food to the twice-born in the order of the planets,
or according to his ability, as available, honouring them according to the rule.

sanskrit_iast:
dhenuḥ śaṅkhas tathānaḍvān hema vāso hayaḥ kramāt /
kṛṣṇā gaur āyasaṃ chāga etā vai dakṣiṇāḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
धेनुः शङ्खस् तथानड्वान् हेम वासो हयः क्रमात् /
कृष्णा गौर् आयसं छाग एता वै दक्षिणाः स्मृताः //
text_mt:
A milch cow, a conch shell, an ox, gold, cloth, a horse in order,
a black cow, iron, and a goat—these are indeed remembered as the sacrificial gifts.

sanskrit_iast:
yaś ca yasya yadā duḥsthaḥ sa taṃ yatnena pūjayet /
brahmaṇaiṣāṃ varo dattaḥ pūjitāḥ pūjayiṣyatha //
meaning:
यश् च यस्य यदा दुःस्थः स तं यत्नेन पूजयेत् /
ब्रह्मणैषां वरो दत्तः पूजिताः पूजयिष्यथ //
text_mt:
And whichever [planet] is ill-placed for anyone at any time, he should worship that one with effort;
for a boon was given to them by Brahmā: ‘Worshipped, you will bring honour.’

sanskrit_iast:
grahādhīnā narendrāṇām ucchrāyāḥ patanāni ca /
bhāvābhāvau ca jagatas tasmāt pūjyatamā grahāḥ //
grahāṇām idam ātithyaṃ kuryāt saṃvatsarād api /
ārogyabalasaṃpanno jīvet sa śaradaḥ śatam //
meaning:
ग्रहाधीना नरेन्द्राणाम् उच्छ्रायाः पतनानि च /
भावाभावौ च जगतस् तस्मात् पूज्यतमा ग्रहाः //
ग्रहाणाम् इदम् आतिथ्यं कुर्यात् संवत्सराद् अपि /
आरोग्यबलसंपन्नो जीवेत् स शरदः शतम् //
text_mt:
Subject to the planets are the rises and falls of kings
and the existence and non-existence of the world; therefore, the planets are most worthy of worship.

One should offer this hospitality to the planets even once a year;
endowed with health and strength, he would live for a hundred autumns.

sanskrit_iast:
mahotsāhaḥ sthūlalakṣaḥ kṛtajño vṛddhasevakaḥ /
vinītaḥ sattvasaṃpannaḥ kulīnaḥ satyavāk śuciḥ //
meaning:
महोत्साहः स्थूललक्षः कृतज्ञो वृद्धसेवकः /
विनीतः सत्त्वसंपन्नः कुलीनः सत्यवाक् शुचिः //
text_mt:
Having great energy, munificent, grateful, serving the aged,
modest, endowed with goodness, of noble family, truthful, pure,

sanskrit_iast:
adīrghasūtraḥ smṛtimān akṣudro 'paruṣas tathā /
dhārmiko 'vyasanaś caiva prājñaḥ śūro rahasyavit //
meaning:
अदीर्घसूत्रः स्मृतिमान् अक्षुद्रो ऽपरुषस् तथा /
धार्मिको ऽव्यसनश् चैव प्राज्ञः शूरो रहस्यवित् //
text_mt:
Not procrastinating, possessing memory, not mean, nor harsh,
observant of duty, free from vices, wise, valorous, knowing secrets,

sanskrit_iast:
svarandhragoptānvīkṣikyāṃ daṇḍanītyāṃ tathaiva ca /
vinītas tv atha vārtāyāṃ trayyāṃ caiva narādhipaḥ //
meaning:
स्वरन्ध्रगोप्तान्वीक्षिक्यां दण्डनीत्यां तथैव च /
विनीतस् त्व् अथ वार्तायां त्रय्यां चैव नराधिपः //
text_mt:
Guarding his weaknesses, trained in philosophy, and likewise in the science of government,
as well as in economics and in the threefold Veda—such a ruler of men

sanskrit_iast:
sa mantriṇaḥ prakurvīta prājñān maulān sthirān śucīn /
taiḥ sārdhaṃ cintayed rājyaṃ vipreṇātha tataḥ svayam //
meaning:
स मन्त्रिणः प्रकुर्वीत प्राज्ञान् मौलान् स्थिरान् शुचीन् /
तैः सार्धं चिन्तयेद् राज्यं विप्रेणाथ ततः स्वयम् //
text_mt:
Should appoint ministers who are wise, hereditary, steadfast, and pure;
with them he should deliberate on the kingdom, then with a Brahmin, and then by himself.

sanskrit_iast:
purohitaṃ prakurvīta daivajñam uditoditam /
daṇḍanītyāṃ ca kuśalam atharvāṅgirase tathā //
meaning:
पुरोहितं प्रकुर्वीत दैवज्ञम् उदितोदितम् /
दण्डनीत्यां च कुशलम् अथर्वाङ्गिरसे तथा //
text_mt:
He should appoint a family priest who is an astrologer, exalted by ancestry and character,
skilled in the science of government and likewise in the Atharvaveda.

sanskrit_iast:
śrautasmārtakriyāhetor vṛṇuyād eva ca rtvijaḥ /
yajñāṃś caiva prakurvīta vidhivad bhūridakṣiṇān //
meaning:
श्रौतस्मार्तक्रियाहेतोर् वृणुयाद् एव च र्त्विजः /
यज्ञांश् चैव प्रकुर्वीत विधिवद् भूरिदक्षिणान् //
text_mt:
For the sake of revealed and traditional rites, he should select sacrificial priests,
and he should perform sacrifices according to rule, with abundant sacrificial gifts.

sanskrit_iast:
bhogāṃś ca dadyād viprebhyo vasūni vividhāni ca /
akṣayo 'yaṃ nidhī rājñāṃ yad vipreṣūpapāditam //
meaning:
भोगांश् च दद्याद् विप्रेभ्यो वसूनि विविधानि च /
अक्षयो ऽयं निधी राज्ञां यद् विप्रेषूपपादितम् //
text_mt:
And he should give enjoyments and various treasures to Brahmins;
this is an inexhaustible treasure of kings—that which is bestowed upon Brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
askannam avyathaṃ caiva prāyaścittair adūṣitam /
agneḥ sakāśād viprāgnau hutaṃ śreṣṭham ihocyate //
meaning:
अस्कन्नम् अव्यथं चैव प्रायश्चित्तैर् अदूषितम् /
अग्नेः सकाशाद् विप्राग्नौ हुतं श्रेष्ठम् इहोच्यते //
text_mt:
Unharmed, without distress, and undefiled by penances,
what is offered into the fire of the Brahmin is said here to be superior to [an offering in] fire.

sanskrit_iast:
alabdham īhed dharmeṇa labdhaṃ yatnena pālayet /
pālitaṃ vardhayen nītyā vṛddhaṃ pātreṣu nikṣipet //
meaning:
अलब्धम् ईहेद् धर्मेण लब्धं यत्नेन पालयेत् /
पालितं वर्धयेन् नीत्या वृद्धं पात्रेषु निक्षिपेत् //
text_mt:
What is unacquired he should seek through duty; what is acquired he should protect with effort;
what is protected he should increase through policy; what is increased he should bestow on worthy recipients.

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā bhūmiṃ nibandhaṃ vā kṛtvā lekhyaṃ tu kārayet /
āgāmibhadranṛpatiparijñānāya pārthivaḥ //
meaning:
दत्त्वा भूमिं निबन्धं वा कृत्वा लेख्यं तु कारयेत् /
आगामिभद्रनृपतिपरिज्ञानाय पार्थिवः //
text_mt:
Having given land or established an endowment, the king should have a written document made,
for the information of future auspicious kings,

sanskrit_iast:
paṭe vā tāmrapaṭṭe vā svamudroparicihnitam /
abhilekhyātmano vaṃśyān ātmānaṃ ca mahīpatiḥ //
meaning:
पटे वा ताम्रपट्टे वा स्वमुद्रोपरिचिह्नितम् /
अभिलेख्यात्मनो वंश्यान् आत्मानं च महीपतिः //
text_mt:
On cloth or on a copper plate, marked above with his own seal;
having inscribed his ancestors and himself, the lord of the earth,

sanskrit_iast:
pratigrahaparīmāṇaṃ dānacchedopavarṇanam /
svahastakālasaṃpannaṃ śāsanaṃ kārayet sthiram //
meaning:
प्रतिग्रहपरीमाणं दानच्छेदोपवर्णनम् /
स्वहस्तकालसंपन्नं शासनं कारयेत् स्थिरम् //
text_mt:
The measurement of the acceptance, a description of the boundaries of the grant,
endowed with his own signature and the date, he should make an enduring edict.

sanskrit_iast:
ramyaṃ paśavyam ājīvyaṃ jāṅgalaṃ deśam āvaset /
tatra durgāṇi kurvīta janakośātmaguptaye //
meaning:
रम्यं पशव्यम् आजीव्यं जाङ्गलं देशम् आवसेत् /
तत्र दुर्गाणि कुर्वीत जनकोशात्मगुप्तये //
text_mt:
He should dwell in a delightful country, good for cattle, offering livelihood, [and] arid;
there he should build fortresses for the protection of his subjects, the treasury, and himself.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra tatra ca niṣṇātān adhyakṣān kuśalān śucīn /
prakuryād āyakarmāntavyayakarmasu codyatān //
meaning:
तत्र तत्र च निष्णातान् अध्यक्षान् कुशलान् शुचीन् /
प्रकुर्याद् आयकर्मान्तव्ययकर्मसु चोद्यतान् //
text_mt:
And in respective matters he should appoint superintendents who are experienced, skilled, pure,
and attentive to revenue, workshops, and expenditure.

sanskrit_iast:
nātaḥ parataro dharmo nṛpāṇāṃ yad raṇārjitam /
viprebhyo dīyate dravyaṃ prajābhyaś cābhayaṃ sadā //
meaning:
नातः परतरो धर्मो नृपाणां यद् रणार्जितम् /
विप्रेभ्यो दीयते द्रव्यं प्रजाभ्यश् चाभयं सदा //
text_mt:
There is no higher duty for kings than this: that wealth acquired in battle
is given to Brahmins, and freedom from fear is always [granted] to subjects.

sanskrit_iast:
ya āhaveṣu vadhyante bhūmyartham aparāṅmukhāḥ /
akūṭair āyudhair yānti te svargaṃ yogino yathā //
meaning:
य आहवेषु वध्यन्ते भूम्यर्थम् अपराङ्मुखाः /
अकूटैर् आयुधैर् यान्ति ते स्वर्गं योगिनो यथा //
text_mt:
Those who are slain in battle for the sake of land, not turning their backs,
go to heaven by means of uncrooked weapons, just like yogins.

sanskrit_iast:
padāni kratutulyāni bhagneṣv avinivartinām /
rājā sukṛtam ādatte hatānāṃ vipalāyinām //
meaning:
पदानि क्रतुतुल्यानि भग्नेष्व् अविनिवर्तिनाम् /
राजा सुकृतम् आदत्ते हतानां विपलायिनाम् //
text_mt:
The steps of those who do not turn back when others are broken are equal to sacrifices.
The king takes the merit of those who flee and are slain.

sanskrit_iast:
tavāhaṃvādinaṃ klībaṃ nirhetiṃ parasaṃgatam /
na hanyād vinivṛttaṃ ca yuddhaprekṣaṇakādikam //
meaning:
तवाहंवादिनं क्लीबं निर्हेतिं परसंगतम् /
न हन्याद् विनिवृत्तं च युद्धप्रेक्षणकादिकम् //
text_mt:
He should not strike one who says 'I am yours', a eunuch, one disarmed, one engaged with another,
one who has turned back, a spectator of the battle, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtarakṣaḥ samutthāya paśyed āyavyayau svayam /
vyavahārāṃs tato dṛṣṭvā snātvā bhuñjīta kāmataḥ //
meaning:
कृतरक्षः समुत्थाय पश्येद् आयव्ययौ स्वयम् /
व्यवहारांस् ततो दृष्ट्वा स्नात्वा भुञ्जीत कामतः //
text_mt:
Having ensured his security and arisen, he should inspect revenue and expenditure himself.
Then, having looked into legal affairs and bathed, he may eat at his pleasure.

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyaṃ vyāpṛtānītaṃ bhāṇḍāgāreṣu nikṣipet /
paśyec cārāṃs tato dūtān preṣayen mantrisaṃgataḥ //
meaning:
हिरण्यं व्यापृतानीतं भाण्डागारेषु निक्षिपेत् /
पश्येच् चारांस् ततो दूतान् प्रेषयेन् मन्त्रिसंगतः //
text_mt:
He should deposit in the treasuries the gold brought by officials.
He should inspect spies, and then dispatch envoys in consultation with his ministers.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ svairavihārī syān mantribhir vā samāgataḥ /
balānāṃ darśanaṃ kṛtvā senānyā saha cintayet //
meaning:
ततः स्वैरविहारी स्यान् मन्त्रिभिर् वा समागतः /
बलानां दर्शनं कृत्वा सेनान्या सह चिन्तयेत् //
text_mt:
Then he may take recreation at will or meet with his ministers.
Having held an inspection of the forces, he should deliberate with the commander of the army.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃdhyām upāsya śṛṇuyāc cārāṇāṃ gūḍhabhāṣitam /
gītanṛtyaiś ca bhuñjīta paṭhet svādhyāyam eva ca //
meaning:
संध्याम् उपास्य शृणुयाच् चाराणां गूढभाषितम् /
गीतनृत्यैश् च भुञ्जीत पठेत् स्वाध्यायम् एव च //
text_mt:
Having performed twilight devotion, he should hear the secret reports of spies.
He should dine with music and dance, and also recite the recitation of the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃviśet tūryaghoṣeṇa pratibudhyet tathaiva ca /
śāstrāṇi cintayed buddhyā sarvakartavyatās tathā //
meaning:
संविशेत् तूर्यघोषेण प्रतिबुध्येत् तथैव च /
शास्त्राणि चिन्तयेद् बुद्ध्या सर्वकर्तव्यतास् तथा //
text_mt:
He should go to rest to the sound of trumpets and awake likewise.
He should reflect in his mind upon the treatises and all duties.

sanskrit_iast:
preṣayec ca tataś cārān sveṣv anyeṣu ca sādarān /
ṛtvikpurohitācāryair āśīrbhir abhinanditaḥ //
meaning:
प्रेषयेच् च ततश् चारान् स्वेष्व् अन्येषु च सादरान् /
ऋत्विक्पुरोहिताचार्यैर् आशीर्भिर् अभिनन्दितः //
text_mt:
Then he should dispatch attentive spies among his own people and among others.
Having been greeted with blessings by the sacrificial priests, the chaplain, and preceptors,

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā jyotirvido vaidyān dadyād gāṃ kāñcanaṃ mahīm /
naiveśikāni ca tataḥ śrotriyebhyo gṛhāṇi ca //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा ज्योतिर्विदो वैद्यान् दद्याद् गां काञ्चनं महीम् /
नैवेशिकानि च ततः श्रोत्रियेभ्यो गृहाणि च //
text_mt:
having received astrologers and physicians, he should give a cow, gold, land,
and marriage gifts, and houses to Vedic scholars.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇeṣu kṣamī snigdheṣv ajihmaḥ krodhano 'riṣu /
syād rājā bhṛtyavargeṣu prajāsu ca yathā pitā //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणेषु क्षमी स्निग्धेष्व् अजिह्मः क्रोधनो ऽरिषु /
स्याद् राजा भृत्यवर्गेषु प्रजासु च यथा पिता //
text_mt:
Patient toward Brahmins, straight toward friends, wrathful toward enemies,
the king should be like a father toward his servants and subjects.

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyāt ṣaḍbhāgam ādatte nyāyena paripālayan /
sarvadānādhikaṃ yasmāt prajānāṃ paripālanam //
meaning:
पुण्यात् षड्भागम् आदत्ते न्यायेन परिपालयन् /
सर्वदानाधिकं यस्मात् प्रजानां परिपालनम् //
text_mt:
Protecting righteously, he takes a sixth part of the religious merit;
for protecting the subjects is greater than all gifts.

sanskrit_iast:
cāṭataskaradurvṛttamahāsāhasikādibhiḥ /
pīḍyamānāḥ prajā rakṣet kāyasthaiś ca viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
चाटतस्करदुर्वृत्तमहासाहसिकादिभिः /
पीड्यमानाः प्रजा रक्षेत् कायस्थैश् च विशेषतः //
text_mt:
He should protect his subjects when they are oppressed by flatterers, thieves, scoundrels,
perpetrators of heinous offences, and especially by scribes.

sanskrit_iast:
arakṣyamāṇāḥ kurvanti yatkiṃcit kilbiṣaṃ prajāḥ /
tasmāt tu nṛpater ardhaṃ yasmād gṛhṇāty asau karān //
meaning:
अरक्ष्यमाणाः कुर्वन्ति यत्किंचित् किल्बिषं प्रजाः /
तस्मात् तु नृपतेर् अर्धं यस्माद् गृह्णात्य् असौ करान् //
text_mt:
Whatever sin the subjects commit when left unprotected,
half of that belongs to the king, since he collects taxes from them.

sanskrit_iast:
ye rāṣṭrādhikṛtās teṣāṃ cārair jñātvā viceṣṭitam /
sādhūn sammānayed rājā viparītāṃś ca ghātayet //
meaning:
ये राष्ट्राधिकृतास् तेषां चारैर् ज्ञात्वा विचेष्टितम् /
साधून् सम्मानयेद् राजा विपरीतांश् च घातयेत् //
text_mt:
Having learned through spies the conduct of those appointed over the kingdom,
the king should honour the good and have the opposite slain.

sanskrit_iast:
utkocajīvino dravyahīnān kṛtvā vivāsayet /
saddānamānasatkārān śrotriyān vāsayet sadā //
meaning:
उत्कोचजीविनो द्रव्यहीनान् कृत्वा विवासयेत् /
सद्दानमानसत्कारान् श्रोत्रियान् वासयेत् सदा //
text_mt:
He should strip of their wealth and banish those who live on bribes;
he should always settle Vedic scholars, honouring them with true gifts and respect.

sanskrit_iast:
anyāyena nṛpo rāṣṭrāt svakośaṃ yo 'bhivardhayet /
so 'cirād vigataśrīko nāśam eti sabāndhavaḥ //
meaning:
अन्यायेन नृपो राष्ट्रात् स्वकोशं यो ऽभिवर्धयेत् /
सो ऽचिराद् विगतश्रीको नाशम् एति सबान्धवः //
text_mt:
The king who unlawfully increases his own treasury from the realm,
he soon loses his prosperity and meets with destruction together with his kinsmen.

sanskrit_iast:
prajāpīḍanasaṃtāpāt samudbhūto hutāśanaḥ /
rājñaḥ kulaṃ śriyaṃ prāṇāṃś cādagdhvā na nivartate //
meaning:
प्रजापीडनसंतापात् समुद्भूतो हुताशनः /
राज्ञः कुलं श्रियं प्राणांश् चादग्ध्वा न निवर्तते //
text_mt:
The fire arisen from the torment of the oppression of the subjects
does not turn back without burning the king's family, prosperity, and life.

sanskrit_iast:
ya eva nṛpater dharmaḥ svarāṣṭraparipālane /
tam eva kṛtsnam āpnoti pararāṣṭraṃ vaśaṃ nayan //
meaning:
य एव नृपतेर् धर्मः स्वराष्ट्रपरिपालने /
तम् एव कृत्स्नम् आप्नोति परराष्ट्रं वशं नयन् //
text_mt:
Whatever is the king's duty in protecting his own realm,
he incurs that entirely when bringing another realm under control.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmin deśe ya ācāro vyavahāraḥ kulasthitiḥ /
tathaiva paripālyo 'sau yadā vaśam upāgataḥ //
meaning:
यस्मिन् देशे य आचारो व्यवहारः कुलस्थितिः /
तथैव परिपाल्यो ऽसौ यदा वशम् उपागतः //
text_mt:
Whatever is the custom, legal practice, and family rule in a country,
that very [rule] must be preserved when it is brought under control.

sanskrit_iast:
mantramūlaṃ yato rājyaṃ tasmān mantraṃ surakṣitam /
kuryād yathāsya na viduḥ karmaṇām āphalodayāt //
meaning:
मन्त्रमूलं यतो राज्यं तस्मान् मन्त्रं सुरक्षितम् /
कुर्याद् यथास्य न विदुः कर्मणाम् आफलोदयात् //
text_mt:
Since counsel is the root of the kingdom, he should keep counsel well guarded,
so that they do not know of his undertakings until the fruition of the result.

sanskrit_iast:
arir mitram udāsīno 'nantaras tatparaḥ paraḥ /
kramaśo maṇḍalaṃ cintyaṃ sāmādibhir upakramaiḥ //
meaning:
अरिर् मित्रम् उदासीनो ऽनन्तरस् तत्परः परः /
क्रमशो मण्डलं चिन्त्यं सामादिभिर् उपक्रमैः //
text_mt:
The enemy, the friend, the neutral, the immediate neighbor, the one beyond him, and the further one:
the circle [of states] should be contemplated in succession with policies beginning with conciliation.

sanskrit_iast:
upāyāḥ sāma dānaṃ ca bhedo daṇḍas tathaiva ca /
samyakprayuktāḥ sidhyeyur daṇḍas tv agatikā gatiḥ //
meaning:
उपायाः साम दानं च भेदो दण्डस् तथैव च /
सम्यक्प्रयुक्ताः सिध्येयुर् दण्डस् त्व् अगतिका गतिः //
text_mt:
Conciliation, gift, division, and force are the expedients;
properly applied, they succeed, but force is the recourse when there is no recourse.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃdhiṃ ca vigrahaṃ yānam āsanaṃ saṃśrayaṃ tathā /
dvaidhībhāvaṃ guṇān etān yathāvat parikalpayet //
meaning:
संधिं च विग्रहं यानम् आसनं संश्रयं तथा /
द्वैधीभावं गुणान् एतान् यथावत् परिकल्पयेत् //
text_mt:
Peace, war, marching, holding ground, seeking refuge,
and dual policy: he should properly apply these six measures of statecraft.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā sasyaguṇopetaṃ pararāṣṭraṃ tadā vrajet /
paraś ca hīna ātmā ca hṛṣṭavāhanapūruṣaḥ //
meaning:
यदा सस्यगुणोपेतं परराष्ट्रं तदा व्रजेत् /
परश् च हीन आत्मा च हृष्टवाहनपूरुषः //
text_mt:
When the enemy's kingdom is endowed with rich crops, then he should march,
and when the enemy is weakened while he himself has spirited conveyances and men.

sanskrit_iast:
daive puruṣakāre ca karmasiddhir vyavasthitā /
tatra daivam abhivyaktaṃ pauruṣaṃ paurvadehikam //
meaning:
दैवे पुरुषकारे च कर्मसिद्धिर् व्यवस्थिता /
तत्र दैवम् अभिव्यक्तं पौरुषं पौर्वदेहिकम् //
text_mt:
The success of action rests on fate and human effort.
There, fate is human effort from a previous body made manifest.

sanskrit_iast:
kecid daivāt svabhāvād vā kālāt puruṣakārataḥ /
saṃyoge kecid icchanti phalaṃ kuśalabuddhayaḥ //
meaning:
केचिद् दैवात् स्वभावाद् वा कालात् पुरुषकारतः /
संयोगे केचिद् इच्छन्ति फलं कुशलबुद्धयः //
text_mt:
Some wish for the fruit from fate, or from nature, from time, or from human effort;
some of skilled intellect [wish for it] from their combination.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā hy ekena cakreṇa rathasya na gatir bhavet /
evaṃ puruṣakāreṇa vinā daivaṃ na sidhyati //
meaning:
यथा ह्य् एकेन चक्रेण रथस्य न गतिर् भवेत् /
एवं पुरुषकारेण विना दैवं न सिध्यति //
text_mt:
For just as there can be no movement of a chariot with one wheel,
so without human effort, fate does not succeed.

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyabhūmilābhebhyo mitralabdhir varā yataḥ /
ato yateta tatprāptyai rakṣet satyaṃ samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
हिरण्यभूमिलाभेभ्यो मित्रलब्धिर् वरा यतः /
अतो यतेत तत्प्राप्त्यै रक्षेत् सत्यं समाहितः //
text_mt:
Since gaining an ally is superior to gaining gold and land,
therefore he should strive for that attainment, and attentively preserve truthfulness.

sanskrit_iast:
svāmy amātyā jano durgaṃ kośo daṇḍas tathaiva ca /
mitrāṇy etāḥ prakṛtayo rājyaṃ saptāṅgam ucyate //
meaning:
स्वाम्य् अमात्या जनो दुर्गं कोशो दण्डस् तथैव च /
मित्राण्य् एताः प्रकृतयो राज्यं सप्ताङ्गम् उच्यते //
text_mt:
The king, the ministers, the people, the fortress, the treasury, and force,
and allies: these are the constituent elements; the kingdom is said to have seven limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
tad avāpya nṛpo daṇḍaṃ durvṛtteṣu nipātayet /
dharmo hi daṇḍarūpeṇa brahmaṇā nirmitaḥ purā //
meaning:
तद् अवाप्य नृपो दण्डं दुर्वृत्तेषु निपातयेत् /
धर्मो हि दण्डरूपेण ब्रह्मणा निर्मितः पुरा //
text_mt:
Having obtained that, the king should strike the wicked with punishment;
for duty was created in ancient times by Brahmā in the form of punishment.

sanskrit_iast:
sa netuṃ nyāyato 'śakyo lubdhenākṛtabuddhinā /
satyasaṃdhena śucinā susahāyena dhīmatā //
meaning:
स नेतुं न्यायतो ऽशक्यो लुब्धेनाकृतबुद्धिना /
सत्यसंधेन शुचिना सुसहायेन धीमता //
text_mt:
It cannot be administered righteously by one who is greedy and untrained in intellect,
[but only] by one true to his promise, pure, having good aides, and wise.

sanskrit_iast:
yathāśāstraṃ prayuktaḥ san sadevāsuramānavam /
jagad ānandayet sarvam anyathā tat prakopayet //
meaning:
यथाशास्त्रं प्रयुक्तः सन् सदेवासुरमानवम् /
जगद् आनन्दयेत् सर्वम् अन्यथा तत् प्रकोपयेत् //
text_mt:
When applied according to the treatises, it gladdens the entire world
with its gods, demons, and humans; otherwise, it enrages it.

sanskrit_iast:
adharmadaṇḍanaṃ svargakīrtilokavināśanam /
samyak tu daṇḍanaṃ rājñaḥ svargakīrtijayāvaham //
meaning:
अधर्मदण्डनं स्वर्गकीर्तिलोकविनाशनम् /
सम्यक् तु दण्डनं राज्ञः स्वर्गकीर्तिजयावहम् //
text_mt:
Unjust punishment ruins heaven, fame, and the worlds;
but the proper punishment brings the king heaven, fame, and victory.

sanskrit_iast:
api bhrātā suto 'rghyo vā śvaśuro mātulo 'pi vā /
nādaṇḍyo nāma rājño 'sti dharmād vicalitaḥ svakāt //
meaning:
अपि भ्राता सुतो ऽर्घ्यो वा श्वशुरो मातुलो ऽपि वा /
नादण्ड्यो नाम राज्ञो ऽस्ति धर्माद् विचलितः स्वकात् //
text_mt:
Be he a brother, a son, an object of reverence, a father-in-law, or a maternal uncle,
none who has deviated from his duty is immune from punishment by the king.

sanskrit_iast:
yo daṇḍyān daṇḍayed rājā samyag vadhyāṃś ca ghātayet /
iṣṭaṃ syāt kratubhis tena samāptavaradakṣiṇaiḥ //
meaning:
यो दण्ड्यान् दण्डयेद् राजा सम्यग् वध्यांश् च घातयेत् /
इष्टं स्यात् क्रतुभिस् तेन समाप्तवरदक्षिणैः //
text_mt:
The king who punishes those deserving of punishment and rightly has those deserving of death slain,
by him sacrifice is offered with rituals completed with excellent sacrificial fees.

sanskrit_iast:
iti saṃcintya nṛpatiḥ kratutulyaphalaṃ pṛthak /
vyavahārān svayaṃ paśyet sabhyaiḥ parivṛto 'nvaham //
meaning:
इति संचिन्त्य नृपतिः क्रतुतुल्यफलं पृथक् /
व्यवहारान् स्वयं पश्येत् सभ्यैः परिवृतो ऽन्वहम् //
text_mt:
Reflecting thus that the individual fruit is equal to a sacrifice,
the king should inspect legal disputes himself daily, surrounded by council members.

sanskrit_iast:
kulāni jātīḥ śreṇīś ca gaṇān jānapadān api /
svadharmāc calitān rājā vinīya sthāpayet pathi //
meaning:
कुलानि जातीः श्रेणीश् च गणान् जानपदान् अपि /
स्वधर्माच् चलितान् राजा विनीय स्थापयेत् पथि //
text_mt:
Families, castes, guilds, corporations, and inhabitants of the realm:
the king, having disciplined those who have strayed from their duty, should establish them on the path.

sanskrit_iast:
jālasūryamarīcisthaṃ trasareṇū rajaḥ smṛtam /
te 'ṣṭau likṣā tu tās tisro rājasarṣapa ucyate //
meaning:
जालसूर्यमरीचिस्थं त्रसरेणू रजः स्मृतम् /
ते ऽष्टौ लिक्षा तु तास् तिस्रो राजसर्षप उच्यते //
text_mt:
The floating speck of dust seen in a ray of sunlight coming through a lattice is considered a dust-particle;
eight of them are a louse-egg; three of those are said to be a black mustard seed.

sanskrit_iast:
gauras tu te trayaḥ ṣaṭ te yavo madhyas tu te trayaḥ /
kṛṣṇalaḥ pañca te māṣas te suvarṇas tu ṣoḍaśa //
meaning:
गौरस् तु ते त्रयः षट् ते यवो मध्यस् तु ते त्रयः /
कृष्णलः पञ्च ते माषस् ते सुवर्णस् तु षोडश //
text_mt:
Three of those are a white [mustard seed]; six of those are a barleycorn; three of those are a medium
kṛṣṇala; five of those are a māṣa; sixteen of those are a suvarṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
palaṃ suvarṇāś catvāraḥ pañca vāpi prakīrtitam /
dve kṛṣṇale rūpyamāṣo dharaṇaṃ ṣoḍaśaiva te //
meaning:
पलं सुवर्णाश् चत्वारः पञ्च वापि प्रकीर्तितम् /
द्वे कृष्णले रूप्यमाषो धरणं षोडशैव ते //
text_mt:
A pala is declared to be four or five suvarṇas.
Two kṛṣṇalas are a silver māṣa; sixteen of those are a dharaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
śatamānaṃ tu daśabhir dharaṇaiḥ palam eva tu /
niṣkaṃ suvarṇāś catvāraḥ kārṣikas tāmrikaḥ paṇaḥ //
meaning:
शतमानं तु दशभिर् धरणैः पलम् एव तु /
निष्कं सुवर्णाश् चत्वारः कार्षिकस् ताम्रिकः पणः //
text_mt:
A śatamāna, however, is ten dharaṇas, and a pala as well;
four suvarṇas are a niṣka; a copper kārṣika is a paṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sāśītipaṇasāhasro daṇḍa uttamasāhasaḥ /
tadardhaṃ madhyamaḥ proktas tadardham adhamaḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
साशीतिपणसाहस्रो दण्ड उत्तमसाहसः /
तदर्धं मध्यमः प्रोक्तस् तदर्धम् अधमः स्मृतः //
text_mt:
A fine of one thousand and eighty paṇas is the highest fine for heinous offences;
half of that is stated to be the middle, and half of that is considered the lowest.

sanskrit_iast:
dhigdaṇḍas tv atha vāgdaṇḍo dhanadaṇḍo vadhas tathā /
yojyā vyastāḥ samastā vā hy aparādhavaśād ime //
meaning:
धिग्दण्डस् त्व् अथ वाग्दण्डो धनदण्डो वधस् तथा /
योज्या व्यस्ताः समस्ता वा ह्य् अपराधवशाद् इमे //
text_mt:
Reprimand, verbal censure, monetary fine, and capital punishment:
these are to be employed separately or together according to the offence.

sanskrit_iast:
jñātvāparādhaṃ deśaṃ ca kālaṃ balam athāpi vā /
vayaḥ karma ca vittaṃ ca daṇḍaṃ daṇḍyeṣu pātayet //
meaning:
ज्ञात्वापराधं देशं च कालं बलम् अथापि वा /
वयः कर्म च वित्तं च दण्डं दण्ड्येषु पातयेत् //
text_mt:
Having ascertained the offence, the place, the time, the strength,
the age, the action, and the wealth, he should inflict punishment on those deserving of punishment.

sanskrit_iast:
vyavahārān nṛpaḥ paśyed vidvadbhir brāhmaṇaiḥ saha /
dharmaśāstrānusāreṇa krodhalobhavivarjitaḥ //
meaning:
व्यवहारान् नृपः पश्येद् विद्वद्भिर् ब्राह्मणैः सह /
धर्मशास्त्रानुसारेण क्रोधलोभविवर्जितः //
title: II. vyavahārādhyāya
text_mt:
The king should examine legal disputes together with learned Brahmins,
in accordance with the treatise on duty, free from anger and greed.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutādhyayanasaṃpannā dharmajñāḥ satyavādinaḥ /
rājñā sabhāsadaḥ kāryā ripau mitre ca ye samāḥ //
meaning:
श्रुताध्ययनसंपन्ना धर्मज्ञाः सत्यवादिनः /
राज्ञा सभासदः कार्या रिपौ मित्रे च ये समाः //
text_mt: Those accomplished in sacred learning and study, knowers of duty, speakers of truth, / and impartial toward foe and friend, should be appointed by the king as court assessors.

sanskrit_iast:
apaśyatā kāryavaśād vyavahārān nṛpeṇa tu /
sabhyaiḥ saha niyoktavyo brāhmaṇaḥ sarvadharmavit //
meaning:
अपश्यता कार्यवशाद् व्यवहारान् नृपेण तु /
सभ्यैः सह नियोक्तव्यो ब्राह्मणः सर्वधर्मवित् //
text_mt: If, however, the king cannot examine legal disputes owing to other affairs, / he should appoint a Brahmin who knows all duty, along with the assessors.

sanskrit_iast:
rāgāl lobhād bhayād vāpi smṛtyapetādikāriṇaḥ /
sabhyāḥ pṛthak pṛthag daṇḍyā vivādād dviguṇaṃ damam //
meaning:
रागाल् लोभाद् भयाद् वापि स्मृत्यपेतादिकारिणः /
सभ्याः पृथक् पृथग् दण्ड्या विवादाद् द्विगुणं दमम् //
text_mt: If assessors act against traditional law through partiality, greed, or fear, / they are each to be punished separately with a fine twice the value of the legal dispute.

sanskrit_iast:
smṛtyācāravyapetena mārgeṇādharṣitaḥ paraiḥ /
āvedayati ced rājñe vyavahārapadaṃ hi tat //
meaning:
स्मृत्याचारव्यपेतेन मार्गेणाधर्षितः परैः /
आवेदयति चेद् राज्ञे व्यवहारपदं हि तत् //
text_mt: When a person aggrieved by others in a manner contrary to traditional law and custom / reports it to the king, that constitutes a cause for legal procedure.

sanskrit_iast:
pratyarthino 'grato lekhyaṃ yathāveditam arthinā /
samāmāsatadardhāharnāmajātyādicihnitam //
meaning:
प्रत्यर्थिनो ऽग्रतो लेख्यं यथावेदितम् अर्थिना /
समामासतदर्धाहर्नामजात्यादिचिह्नितम् //
text_mt: In the presence of the defendant, the claim made by the plaintiff should be recorded, / marked by year, month, fortnight, day, name, caste, and so forth.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutārthasyottaraṃ lekhyaṃ pūrvāvedakasaṃnidhau /
tato 'rthī lekhayet sadyaḥ pratijñātārthasādhanam //
meaning:
श्रुतार्थस्योत्तरं लेख्यं पूर्वावेदकसंनिधौ /
ततो ऽर्थी लेखयेत् सद्यः प्रतिज्ञातार्थसाधनम् //
text_mt: Once he has heard the matter, the answer [of the defendant] should be recorded in the presence of the complainant; / thereupon the plaintiff must immediately cause the proof of the matter asserted to be recorded.

sanskrit_iast:
tatsiddhau siddhim āpnoti viparītam ato 'nyathā /
catuṣpād vyavahāro 'yaṃ vivādeṣūpadarśitaḥ //
meaning:
तत्सिद्धौ सिद्धिम् आप्नोति विपरीतम् अतो ऽन्यथा /
चतुष्पाद् व्यवहारो ऽयं विवादेषूपदर्शितः //
text_mt: If that is established, he achieves success; if otherwise, the reverse. / This legal procedure is declared to consist of four feet in legal disputes.

sanskrit_iast:
abhiyogam anistīrya nainaṃ pratyabhiyojayet /
abhiyuktaṃ ca nānyena noktaṃ viprakṛtiṃ nayet //
meaning:
अभियोगम् अनिस्तीर्य नैनं प्रत्यभियोजयेत् /
अभियुक्तं च नान्येन नोक्तं विप्रकृतिं नयेत् //
text_mt: Without refuting the accusation, one should not bring a counter-accusation against him, / nor may one alter what has already been stated by an accused person or by another.

sanskrit_iast:
kuryāt pratyabhiyogaṃ ca kalahe sāhaseṣu ca /
ubhayoḥ pratibhūr grāhyaḥ samarthaḥ kāryanirṇaye //
meaning:
कुर्यात् प्रत्यभियोगं च कलहे साहसेषु च /
उभयोः प्रतिभूर् ग्राह्यः समर्थः कार्यनिर्णये //
text_mt: One may, however, make a counter-accusation in cases of brawl and heinous offences. / For both parties, a surety capable of fulfilling the determination of the suit should be taken.

sanskrit_iast:
nihnave bhāvito dadyād dhanaṃ rājñe ca tatsamam /
mithyābhiyogī dviguṇam abhiyogād dhanaṃ vahet //
meaning:
निह्नवे भावितो दद्याद् धनं राज्ञे च तत्समम् /
मिथ्याभियोगी द्विगुणम् अभियोगाद् धनं वहेत् //
text_mt: If convicted after denial, he shall pay the money and an equal amount to the king; / a false accuser shall pay twice the amount of the claim.

sanskrit_iast:
sāhasasteyapāruṣyago'bhiśāpātyaye striyām /
vivādayet sadya eva kālo 'nyatrecchayā smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
साहसस्तेयपारुष्यगोऽभिशापात्यये स्त्रियाम् /
विवादयेत् सद्य एव कालो ऽन्यत्रेच्छया स्मृतः //
text_mt: In cases of heinous offence, theft, assault, insult, emergency concerning a cow, and regarding a woman, / the trial must be held immediately; in other cases, a delay is prescribed according to desire.

sanskrit_iast:
deśād deśāntaraṃ yāti sṛkkiṇī parileḍhi ca /
lalāṭaṃ svidyate cāsya mukhaṃ vaivarṇyam eti ca //
meaning:
देशाद् देशान्तरं याति सृक्किणी परिलेढि च /
ललाटं स्विद्यते चास्य मुखं वैवर्ण्यम् एति च //
text_mt: He who moves from place to place, repeatedly licks the corners of his mouth, / whose forehead sweats, and whose face loses its colour,

sanskrit_iast:
pariśuṣyatskhaladvākyo viruddhaṃ bahu bhāṣite /
vākcakṣuḥ pūjayati no tathauṣṭhau nirbhujaty api //
meaning:
परिशुष्यत्स्खलद्वाक्यो विरुद्धं बहु भाषिते /
वाक्चक्षुः पूजयति नो तथौष्ठौ निर्भुजत्य् अपि //
text_mt: whose speech dries up and falters, who says much that is contradictory, / who does not meet one's words or gaze, and bites his lips,

sanskrit_iast:
svabhāvād vikṛtiṃ gacchen manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ /
abhiyoge 'tha sākṣye vā duṣṭaḥ sa parikīrtitaḥ //
meaning:
स्वभावाद् विकृतिं गच्छेन् मनोवाक्कायकर्मभिः /
अभियोगे ऽथ साक्ष्ये वा दुष्टः स परिकीर्तितः //
text_mt: who undergoes an unnatural change through mind, speech, and bodily actions— / he is declared corrupt, whether in an accusation or in testimony.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃdigdhārthaṃ svatantro yaḥ sādhayed yaś ca niṣpatet /
na cāhūto vadet kiṃcid dhīno daṇḍyaś ca sa smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
संदिग्धार्थं स्वतन्त्रो यः साधयेद् यश् च निष्पतेत् /
न चाहूतो वदेत् किंचिद् धीनो दण्ड्यश् च स स्मृतः //
text_mt: He who on his own recovers a disputed claim, or flees, / or says nothing when summoned, is held to have lost and is to be fined.

sanskrit_iast:
sākṣiṣūbhayataḥ satsu sākṣiṇaḥ pūrvavādinaḥ /
pūrvapakṣe 'dharībhūte bhavanty uttaravādinaḥ //
meaning:
साक्षिषूभयतः सत्सु साक्षिणः पूर्ववादिनः /
पूर्वपक्षे ऽधरीभूते भवन्त्य् उत्तरवादिनः //
text_mt: When there are witnesses on both sides, the witnesses of the claimant [are to be heard]; / if the prima facie case is refuted, those of the respondent are heard.

sanskrit_iast:
sapaṇaś ced vivādaḥ syāt tatra hīnaṃ tu dāpayet /
daṇḍaṃ ca svapaṇaṃ caiva dhanine dhanam eva ca //
meaning:
सपणश् चेद् विवादः स्यात् तत्र हीनं तु दापयेत् /
दण्डं च स्वपणं चैव धनिने धनम् एव च //
text_mt: If the legal dispute involves a wager, the loser must be made to pay / the fine, his own wager, and the debt itself to the creditor.

sanskrit_iast:
chalaṃ nirasya bhūtena vyavahārān nayen nṛpaḥ /
bhūtam apy anupanyastaṃ hīyate vyavahārataḥ //
meaning:
छलं निरस्य भूतेन व्यवहारान् नयेन् नृपः /
भूतम् अप्य् अनुपन्यस्तं हीयते व्यवहारतः //
text_mt: Rejecting deception, the king should conduct legal proceedings according to the facts; / yet even a fact, if not presented, is lost through legal procedure.

sanskrit_iast:
nihnute likhitaṃ naikam ekadeśe vibhāvitaḥ /
dāpyaḥ sarvaṃ nṛpeṇārthaṃ na grāhyas tv aniveditaḥ //
meaning:
निह्नुते लिखितं नैकम् एकदेशे विभावितः /
दाप्यः सर्वं नृपेणार्थं न ग्राह्यस् त्व् अनिवेदितः //
text_mt: If one denies all items listed, but is proved liable in one part, / he must be made by the king to pay the whole amount; but what was not claimed cannot be recovered.

sanskrit_iast:
smṛtyor virodhe nyāyas tu balavān vyavahārataḥ /
arthaśāstrāt tu balavad dharmaśāstram iti sthitiḥ //
meaning:
स्मृत्योर् विरोधे न्यायस् तु बलवान् व्यवहारतः /
अर्थशास्त्रात् तु बलवद् धर्मशास्त्रम् इति स्थितिः //
text_mt: In the case of a conflict between two legal traditions, equity prevails in legal procedure; / but the rule is that a treatise on duty is stronger than a treatise on worldly profit.

sanskrit_iast:
pramāṇaṃ likhitaṃ bhuktiḥ sākṣiṇaś ceti kīrtitam /
eṣām anyatamābhāve divyānyatamam ucyate //
meaning:
प्रमाणं लिखितं भुक्तिः साक्षिणश् चेति कीर्तितम् /
एषाम् अन्यतमाभावे दिव्यान्यतमम् उच्यते //
text_mt: Proof is declared to be written evidence, possession, and witnesses; / in the absence of any of these, one of the ordeals is prescribed.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣv arthavivādeṣu balavaty uttarākriyā /
ādhau pratigrahe krīte pūrvā tu balavattarā //
meaning:
सर्वेष्व् अर्थविवादेषु बलवत्य् उत्तराक्रिया /
आधौ प्रतिग्रहे क्रीते पूर्वा तु बलवत्तरा //
text_mt: In all disputes over property, a later act carries greater weight; / but in the case of a pledge, a gift, or a purchase, the earlier act is stronger.

sanskrit_iast:
paśyato 'bruvato bhūmer hānir viṃśativārṣikī /
pareṇa bhujyamānāyā dhanasya daśavārṣikī //
meaning:
पश्यतो ऽब्रुवतो भूमेर् हानिर् विंशतिवार्षिकी /
परेण भुज्यमानाया धनस्य दशवार्षिकी //
text_mt: For land being enjoyed by another before the owner's eyes without his speaking, the loss occurs in twenty years; / for movable property, in ten years.

sanskrit_iast:
ādhisīmopanikṣepajaḍabāladhanair vinā /
tathopanidhirājastrīśrotriyāṇāṃ dhanair api //
meaning:
आधिसीमोपनिक्षेपजडबालधनैर् विना /
तथोपनिधिराजस्त्रीश्रोत्रियाणां धनैर् अपि //
text_mt: Excepting pledges, boundaries, open deposits, the property of idiots and minors, / as well as sealed deposits, and the property of the king, women, and learned Brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
ādhyādīnāṃ vihartāraṃ dhanine dāpayed dhanam /
daṇḍaṃ ca tatsamaṃ rājñe śaktyapekṣam athāpi vā //
meaning:
आध्यादीनां विहर्तारं धनिने दापयेद् धनम् /
दण्डं च तत्समं राज्ञे शक्त्यपेक्षम् अथापि वा //
text_mt: One who appropriates a pledge and the like must be made to return the property to the owner, / and to pay an equal fine to the king, or according to his means.

sanskrit_iast:
āgamo 'bhyadhiko bhogād vinā pūrvakramāgatāt /
āgame 'pi balaṃ naiva bhuktiḥ stokāpi yatra no //
meaning:
आगमो ऽभ्यधिको भोगाद् विना पूर्वक्रमागतात् /
आगमे ऽपि बलं नैव भुक्तिः स्तोकापि यत्र नो //
text_mt: Title is superior to possession, except when handed down through ancestral succession; / yet even with title, there is no strength where possession is not even slight.

sanskrit_iast:
āgamas tu kṛto yena so 'bhiyuktas tam uddharet /
na tatsutas tatsuto vā bhuktis tatra garīyasī //
meaning:
आगमस् तु कृतो येन सो ऽभियुक्तस् तम् उद्धरेत् /
न तत्सुतस् तत्सुतो वा भुक्तिस् तत्र गरीयसी //
text_mt: He by whom the title was acquired must establish it when sued, / but not his son or his son's son; in their case, possession carries greater weight.

sanskrit_iast:
yo 'bhiyuktaḥ paretaḥ syāt tasya rikthī tam uddharet /
na tatra kāraṇaṃ bhuktir āgamena vinākṛtā //
meaning:
यो ऽभियुक्तः परेतः स्यात् तस्य रिक्थी तम् उद्धरेत् /
न तत्र कारणं भुक्तिर् आगमेन विनाकृता //
text_mt: If one who has been sued dies, his heir must establish the title; / there, possession unsupported by title is no proof.

sanskrit_iast:
nṛpeṇādhikṛtāḥ pūgāḥ śreṇayo 'tha kulāni ca /
pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ guru jñeyaṃ vyavahāravidhau nṛṇām //
meaning:
नृपेणाधिकृताः पूगाः श्रेणयो ऽथ कुलानि च /
पूर्वं पूर्वं गुरु ज्ञेयं व्यवहारविधौ नृणाम् //
text_mt: Officers appointed by the king, corporate assemblies, guilds, and families: / each preceding one is to be regarded as weightier in judicial procedure for men.

sanskrit_iast:
balopādhivinirvṛttān vyavahārān nivartayet /
strīnaktamantarāgārabahiḥśatrukṛtāṃs tathā //
meaning:
बलोपाधिविनिर्वृत्तान् व्यवहारान् निवर्तयेत् /
स्त्रीनक्तमन्तरागारबहिःशत्रुकृतांस् तथा //
text_mt: Transactions brought about by force or fraudulent misrepresentation should be annulled, / as also those made by women, at night, inside a house, outside, or by enemies.

sanskrit_iast:
mattonmattārtavyasanibālabhītādiyojitaḥ /
asaṃbaddhakṛtaś caiva vyavahāro na sidhyati //
meaning:
मत्तोन्मत्तार्तव्यसनिबालभीतादियोजितः /
असंबद्धकृतश् चैव व्यवहारो न सिध्यति //
text_mt: A transaction entered into by an intoxicated person, a lunatic, one afflicted, an addict, a minor, a frightened person, and the like, / or made by an unauthorised person, does not hold valid.

sanskrit_iast:
pranaṣṭādhigataṃ deyaṃ nṛpeṇa dhanine dhanam /
vibhāvayen na cel liṅgais tatsamaṃ daṇḍam arhati //
meaning:
प्रनष्टाधिगतं देयं नृपेण धनिने धनम् /
विभावयेन् न चेल् लिङ्गैस् तत्समं दण्डम् अर्हति //
text_mt: Property lost and found should be returned by the king to the owner; / if he fails to prove ownership by identifying marks, he deserves a fine equal to it.

sanskrit_iast:
rājā labdhvā nidhiṃ dadyād dvijebhyo 'rdhaṃ dvijaḥ punaḥ /
vidvān aśeṣam ādadyāt sa sarvasya prabhur yataḥ //
meaning:
राजा लब्ध्वा निधिं दद्याद् द्विजेभ्यो ऽर्धं द्विजः पुनः /
विद्वान् अशेषम् आदद्यात् स सर्वस्य प्रभुर् यतः //
text_mt: A king, having found a treasure trove, should give half to twice-born men; / a learned twice-born man, however, may take the whole, since he is master of everything.

sanskrit_iast:
itareṇa nidhau labdhe rājā ṣaṣṭhāṃśam āharet /
aniveditavijñāto dāpyas taṃ daṇḍam eva ca //
meaning:
इतरेण निधौ लब्धे राजा षष्ठांशम् आहरेत् /
अनिवेदितविज्ञातो दाप्यस् तं दण्डम् एव च //
text_mt: If a treasure trove is found by any other person, the king shall take a sixth share; / if it is discovered without having been reported, he shall also make him pay a fine.

sanskrit_iast:
deyaṃ caurahṛtaṃ dravyaṃ rājñā jānapadāya tu /
adadad dhi samāpnoti kilbiṣaṃ yasya tasya tat //
meaning:
देयं चौरहृतं द्रव्यं राज्ञा जानपदाय तु /
अददद् धि समाप्नोति किल्बिषं यस्य तस्य तत् //
text_mt: Property carried off by thieves must be restored by the king to the inhabitant of the countryside; / for if he does not restore it, he incurs that person's sin.

sanskrit_iast:
aśītibhāgo vṛddhiḥ syān māsi māsi sabandhake /
varṇakramāc chataṃ dvitricatuṣpañcakam anyathā //
meaning:
अशीतिभागो वृद्धिः स्यान् मासि मासि सबन्धके /
वर्णक्रमाच् छतं द्वित्रिचतुष्पञ्चकम् अन्यथा //
text_mt: An eightieth part should be the interest month by month where there is a pledge; / otherwise, it is two, three, four, or five percent in order of the social classes.

sanskrit_iast:
kāntāragās tu daśakaṃ sāmudrā viṃśakaṃ śatam /
dadyur vā svakṛtāṃ vṛddhiṃ sarve sarvāsu jātiṣu //
meaning:
कान्तारगास् तु दशकं सामुद्रा विंशकं शतम् /
दद्युर् वा स्वकृतां वृद्धिं सर्वे सर्वासु जातिषु //
text_mt: Those travelling through wildernesses should pay ten percent, and sea-voyagers twenty percent; / or all of every class may pay the interest agreed upon by themselves.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃtatis tu paśustrīṇāṃ rasasyāṣṭaguṇā parā /
vastradhānyahiraṇyānāṃ catustridviguṇā parā //
meaning:
संततिस् तु पशुस्त्रीणां रसस्याष्टगुणा परा /
वस्त्रधान्यहिरण्यानां चतुस्त्रिद्विगुणा परा //
text_mt: The maximum return on female animals is their offspring; on fluids, eightfold; / on garments, grains, and gold, the maximum is fourfold, threefold, and twofold respectively.

sanskrit_iast:
prapannaṃ sādhayann arthaṃ na vācyo nṛpater bhavet /
sādhyamāno nṛpaṃ gacchan daṇḍyo dāpyaś ca taddhanam //
meaning:
प्रपन्नं साधयन्न् अर्थं न वाच्यो नृपतेर् भवेत् /
साध्यमानो नृपं गच्छन् दण्ड्यो दाप्यश् च तद्धनम् //
text_mt: A creditor recovering an admitted debt should not be censured by the king; / a debtor who complains to the king while being made to pay is to be fined and made to pay the debt.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītānukramād dāpyo dhaninām adhamarṇikaḥ /
dattvā tu brāhmaṇāyaiva nṛpates tadanantaram //
meaning:
गृहीतानुक्रमाद् दाप्यो धनिनाम् अधमर्णिकः /
दत्त्वा तु ब्राह्मणायैव नृपतेस् तदनन्तरम् //
text_mt: A debtor must be made to pay his creditors in the order the debts were contracted, / but only after paying a Brahmin, and immediately after that the king.

sanskrit_iast:
rājñādhamarṇiko dāpyaḥ sādhitād daśakaṃ śatam /
pañcakaṃ ca śataṃ dāpyaḥ prāptārtho hy uttamarṇikaḥ //
meaning:
राज्ञाधमर्णिको दाप्यः साधिताद् दशकं शतम् /
पञ्चकं च शतं दाप्यः प्राप्तार्थो ह्य् उत्तमर्णिकः //
text_mt: A debtor shall be made by the king to pay ten percent of the recovered debt, / and a creditor who has received his money shall be made to pay five percent.

sanskrit_iast:
hīnajātiṃ parikṣīṇam ṛṇārthaṃ karma kārayet /
brāhmaṇas tu parikṣīṇaḥ śanair dāpyo yathodayam //
meaning:
हीनजातिं परिक्षीणम् ऋणार्थं कर्म कारयेत् /
ब्राह्मणस् तु परिक्षीणः शनैर् दाप्यो यथोदयम् //
text_mt: One of lower caste who is destitute may be made to do labour to pay off a debt; / a destitute Brahmin, however, should be made to pay gradually as he acquires means.

sanskrit_iast:
dīyamānaṃ na gṛhṇāti prayuktaṃ yaḥ svakaṃ dhanam /
madhyasthasthāpitaṃ cet syād vardhate na tataḥ param //
meaning:
दीयमानं न गृह्णाति प्रयुक्तं यः स्वकं धनम् /
मध्यस्थस्थापितं चेत् स्याद् वर्धते न ततः परम् //
text_mt: If a creditor does not accept his lent money when offered, / and it is deposited with an impartial person, it ceases to bear interest from that time on.

sanskrit_iast:
