text_mt: purification of sattva through the removal of rajas and tamas, freedom from craving, and tranquillity— / purified by these means, endowed with sattva, one becomes immortal.

sanskrit_iast:
tattvasmṛter upasthānāt sattvayogāt parikṣayāt /
karmaṇāṃ saṃnikarṣāc ca satāṃ yogaḥ pravartate //
meaning:
तत्त्वस्मृतेर् उपस्थानात् सत्त्वयोगात् परिक्षयात् /
कर्मणां संनिकर्षाच् च सतां योगः प्रवर्तते //
text_mt: Through the presence of memory of the reality, through union with sattva, through the destruction / of actions, and through proximity to the virtuous, yoga proceeds.

sanskrit_iast:
śarīrasaṃkṣaye yasya manaḥ sattvastham īśvaram /
aviplutamatiḥ samyak sa jātisaṃsmaratām iyāt //
meaning:
शरीरसंक्षये यस्य मनः सत्त्वस्थम् ईश्वरम् /
अविप्लुतमतिः सम्यक् स जातिसंस्मरताम् इयात् //
text_mt: At the dissolution of the body, he whose mind is fixed on purity [and] the Lord, / with an unwavering intellect, fully attains the recollection of his former births.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā hi bharato varṇair varṇayaty ātmanas tanum /
nānārūpāṇi kurvāṇas tathātmā karmajās tanūḥ //
meaning:
यथा हि भरतो वर्णैर् वर्णयत्य् आत्मनस् तनुम् /
नानारूपाणि कुर्वाणस् तथात्मा कर्मजास् तनूः //
text_mt: For just as an actor colours his body with paints / creating various forms, so does the self [assume] bodies born of action.

sanskrit_iast:
kālakarmātmabījānāṃ doṣair mātus tathaiva ca /
garbhasya vaikṛtaṃ dṛṣṭam aṅgahīnādi janmanaḥ //
meaning:
कालकर्मात्मबीजानां दोषैर् मातुस् तथैव च /
गर्भस्य वैकृतं दृष्टम् अङ्गहीनादि जन्मनः //
text_mt: Through defects of time, action, the self's seed, and likewise of the mother, / deformity of the embryo is observed, such as being born lacking limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃkāreṇa manasā gatyā karmaphalena ca /
śarīreṇa ca nātmāyaṃ muktapūrvaḥ kathaṃcana //
meaning:
अहंकारेण मनसा गत्या कर्मफलेन च /
शरीरेण च नात्मायं मुक्तपूर्वः कथंचन //
text_mt: Never before has this self been liberated from egoism, / mind, transmigration, the fruit of action, and the physical body.

sanskrit_iast:
vartyādhārasnehayogād yathā dīpasya saṃsthitiḥ /
vikriyāpi ca dṛṣṭaivam akāle prāṇasaṃkṣayaḥ //
meaning:
वर्त्याधारस्नेहयोगाद् यथा दीपस्य संस्थितिः /
विक्रियापि च दृष्टैवम् अकाले प्राणसंक्षयः //
text_mt: Just as the persistence of a lamp depends on the combination of wick, base, and oil, / and its destruction is likewise observed, so occurs premature exhaustion of vital breath.

sanskrit_iast:
anantā raśmayas tasya dīpavad yaḥ sthito hṛdi /
sitāsitāḥ karburūpāḥ kapilā nīlalohitāḥ //
meaning:
अनन्ता रश्मयस् तस्य दीपवद् यः स्थितो हृदि /
सितासिताः कर्बुरूपाः कपिला नीललोहिताः //
text_mt: Endless are the rays of him who dwells like a lamp in the heart: / white, black, variegated, tawny, dark blue, and red.

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhvam ekaḥ sthitas teṣāṃ yo bhittvā sūryamaṇḍalam /
brahmalokam atikramya tena yāti parāṃ gatim //
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वम् एकः स्थितस् तेषां यो भित्त्वा सूर्यमण्डलम् /
ब्रह्मलोकम् अतिक्रम्य तेन याति परां गतिम् //
text_mt: One of them extends upwards; piercing the orb of the sun / and passing beyond the realm of Brahmā, one attains through it the supreme goal.

sanskrit_iast:
yad asyānyad raśmiśatam ūrdhvam eva vyavasthitam /
tena devaśarīrāṇi sadhāmāni prapadyate //
meaning:
यद् अस्यान्यद् रश्मिशतम् ऊर्ध्वम् एव व्यवस्थितम् /
तेन देवशरीराणि सधामानि प्रपद्यते //
text_mt: Through the hundred other rays of his that are also directed upwards, / one attains the bodies of gods along with their celestial abodes.

sanskrit_iast:
ye 'nekarūpāś cādhastād raśmayo 'sya mṛduprabhāḥ /
iha karmopabhogāya taiḥ saṃsarati so 'vaśaḥ //
meaning:
ये ऽनेकरूपाश् चाधस्ताद् रश्मयो ऽस्य मृदुप्रभाः /
इह कर्मोपभोगाय तैः संसरति सो ऽवशः //
text_mt: Those multiform rays of his extending downwards, endowed with soft radiance— / by means of them, helpless, he transmigrates here to experience [the fruits of] action.

sanskrit_iast:
vedaiḥ śāstraiḥ savijñānair janmanā maraṇena ca /
ārtyā gatyā tathāgatyā satyena hy anṛtena ca //
meaning:
वेदैः शास्त्रैः सविज्ञानैर् जन्मना मरणेन च /
आर्त्या गत्या तथागत्या सत्येन ह्य् अनृतेन च //
text_mt: Through the Vedas, the treatises along with higher knowledge, through birth and death, / through distress, departure, and return, through truth and falsehood,

sanskrit_iast:
śreyasā sukhaduḥkhābhyāṃ karmabhiś ca śubhāśubhaiḥ /
nimittaśākunajñānagrahasaṃyogajaiḥ phalaiḥ //
meaning:
श्रेयसा सुखदुःखाभ्यां कर्मभिश् च शुभाशुभैः /
निमित्तशाकुनज्ञानग्रहसंयोगजैः फलैः //
text_mt: through the highest good, pleasure and pain, through good and evil deeds, / through the results born of the knowledge of omens, auguries, and planetary conjunctions,

sanskrit_iast:
tārānakṣatrasaṃcārair jāgaraiḥ svapnajair api /
ākāśapavanajyotirjalabhūtimirais tathā //
meaning:
तारानक्षत्रसंचारैर् जागरैः स्वप्नजैर् अपि /
आकाशपवनज्योतिर्जलभूतिमिरैस् तथा //
text_mt: through the movements of stars and asterisms, waking states, and those born of dreams, / and likewise through space, wind, fire, water, and earth,

sanskrit_iast:
manvantarair yugaprāptyā mantrauṣadhiphalair api /
vittātmānaṃ vedyamānaṃ kāraṇaṃ jagatas tathā //
meaning:
मन्वन्तरैर् युगप्राप्त्या मन्त्रौषधिफलैर् अपि /
वित्तात्मानं वेद्यमानं कारणं जगतस् तथा //
text_mt: through cosmic eras, the arrival of world-ages, and the fruits of mantras and medicinal herbs— / know the self as the object of knowledge and the cause of the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃkāraḥ smṛtir medhā dveṣo buddhiḥ sukhaṃ dhṛtiḥ /
indriyāntarasaṃcāra icchā dhāraṇajīvite //
meaning:
अहंकारः स्मृतिर् मेधा द्वेषो बुद्धिः सुखं धृतिः /
इन्द्रियान्तरसंचार इच्छा धारणजीविते //
text_mt: Egoism, memory, intellect, hatred, discernment, pleasure, resolve, / the movement between different sense organs, desire, bodily sustenance and life,

sanskrit_iast:
svargaḥ svapnaś ca bhāvānāṃ preraṇaṃ manaso gatiḥ /
nimeṣaś cetanā yatna ādānaṃ pāñcabhautikam //
meaning:
स्वर्गः स्वप्नश् च भावानां प्रेरणं मनसो गतिः /
निमेषश् चेतना यत्न आदानं पाञ्चभौतिकम् //
text_mt: heaven, dream, the impulse of mental states, the movement of the mind, / blinking, consciousness, effort, and the acquisition of the five elements—

sanskrit_iast:
yata etāni dṛśyante liṅgāni paramātmanaḥ /
tasmād asti paro dehād ātmā sarvaga īśvaraḥ //
meaning:
यत एतानि दृश्यन्ते लिङ्गानि परमात्मनः /
तस्माद् अस्ति परो देहाद् आत्मा सर्वग ईश्वरः //
text_mt: since these are observed as the marks of the Supreme Self, / therefore there is a self beyond the body, all-pervading and sovereign.

sanskrit_iast:
buddhīndriyāṇi sārthāni manaḥ karmendriyāṇi ca /
ahaṃkāraś ca buddhiś ca pṛthivyādīni caiva hi //
meaning:
बुद्धीन्द्रियाणि सार्थानि मनः कर्मेन्द्रियाणि च /
अहंकारश् च बुद्धिश् च पृथिव्यादीनि चैव हि //
text_mt: The sense organs along with their objects, the mind, the organs of action, / egoism, intellect, and earth and the other [elements],

sanskrit_iast:
avyaktam ātmā kṣetrajñaḥ kṣetrasyāsya nigadyate /
īśravaḥ sarvabhūtasthaḥ sann asan sad asac ca yaḥ //
meaning:
अव्यक्तम् आत्मा क्षेत्रज्ञः क्षेत्रस्यास्य निगद्यते /
ईश्रवः सर्वभूतस्थः सन्न् असन् सद् असच् च यः //
text_mt: the unmanifest, and the self are declared as the knower of the field of this field— / the Lord dwelling in all beings, who is existence, non-existence, and both existence and non-existence.

sanskrit_iast:
buddher utpattir avyaktāt tato 'haṃkārasaṃbhavaḥ /
tanmātrādīny ahaṃkārād ekottaraguṇāni ca //
meaning:
बुद्धेर् उत्पत्तिर् अव्यक्तात् ततो ऽहंकारसंभवः /
तन्मात्रादीन्य् अहंकाराद् एकोत्तरगुणानि च //
text_mt: The arising of the intellect is from the unmanifest; from that arises egoism; / from egoism arise the subtle elements and the rest, having successively one additional quality.

sanskrit_iast:
śabdaḥ sparśaś ca rūpaṃ ca raso gandhaś ca tadguṇāḥ /
yo yasmān niḥsṛtaś caiṣāṃ sa tasminn eva līyate //
meaning:
शब्दः स्पर्शश् च रूपं च रसो गन्धश् च तद्गुणाः /
यो यस्मान् निःसृतश् चैषां स तस्मिन्न् एव लीयते //
text_mt: Sound, touch, form, taste, and smell are their qualities; / whichever has emerged from whatever dissolves back into that very thing.

sanskrit_iast:
yathātmānaṃ sṛjaty ātmā tathā vaḥ kathito mayā /
vipākāt triprakārāṇāṃ karmaṇām īśvaro 'pi san //
meaning:
यथात्मानं सृजत्य् आत्मा तथा वः कथितो मया /
विपाकात् त्रिप्रकाराणां कर्मणाम् ईश्वरो ऽपि सन् //
text_mt: Thus has it been declared to you by me how the self creates itself, / even though it is the Lord, through the ripening of the three kinds of action.

sanskrit_iast:
sattvaṃ rajas tamaś caiva guṇās tasyaiva kīrtitāḥ /
rajastamobhyām āviṣṭaś cakravad bhrāmyate hy asau //
meaning:
सत्त्वं रजस् तमश् चैव गुणास् तस्यैव कीर्तिताः /
रजस्तमोभ्याम् आविष्टश् चक्रवद् भ्राम्यते ह्य् असौ //
text_mt: Purity, passion, and darkness are celebrated as its very qualities; / enveloped by passion and darkness, it is indeed whirled around like a wheel.

sanskrit_iast:
anādir ādimāṃś caiva sa eva puruṣaḥ paraḥ /
liṅgendriyagrāhyarūpaḥ savikāra udāhṛtaḥ //
meaning:
अनादिर् आदिमांश् चैव स एव पुरुषः परः /
लिङ्गेन्द्रियग्राह्यरूपः सविकार उदाहृतः //
text_mt: Beginningless yet possessing a beginning, that very one is the supreme person; / having a form perceptible through bodily marks and senses, he is declared subject to modification.

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛyāno 'javīthyāś ca yad agastyasya cāntaram /
tenāgnihotriṇo yānti svargakāmā divaṃ prati //
meaning:
पितृयानो ऽजवीथ्याश् च यद् अगस्त्यस्य चान्तरम् /
तेनाग्निहोत्रिणो यान्ति स्वर्गकामा दिवं प्रति //
text_mt: The space between the path of the ancestors, the Goat's Way, and Agastya— / along that path the performers of the Agnihotra, desiring heaven, proceed to the sky.

sanskrit_iast:
ye ca dānaparāḥ samyag aṣṭābhiś ca guṇair yutāḥ /
te 'pi tenaiva mārgeṇa satyavrataparāyaṇāḥ //
meaning:
ये च दानपराः सम्यग् अष्टाभिश् च गुणैर् युताः /
ते ऽपि तेनैव मार्गेण सत्यव्रतपरायणाः //
text_mt: And those devoted to generosity, properly endowed with the eight virtues, / dedicated to the vow of truth, also go by that very path.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāṣṭāśītisāhasramunayo gṛhamedhinaḥ /
punarāvartino bījabhūtā dharmapravartakāḥ //
meaning:
तत्राष्टाशीतिसाहस्रमुनयो गृहमेधिनः /
पुनरावर्तिनो बीजभूता धर्मप्रवर्तकाः //
text_mt: There dwell eighty-eight thousand householder sages / who return again, serving as the seeds [of mankind] and promoters of duty.

sanskrit_iast:
saptarṣināgavīthyantar devalokaṃ samāśritāḥ /
tāvanta eva munayaḥ sarvārambhavivarjitāḥ //
meaning:
सप्तर्षिनागवीथ्यन्तर् देवलोकं समाश्रिताः /
तावन्त एव मुनयः सर्वारम्भविवर्जिताः //
text_mt: Between the Seven Seers and the Serpent's Way, settled in the realm of the gods, / are just as many sages who have abandoned all worldly undertakings.

sanskrit_iast:
tapasā brahmacaryeṇa saṅgatyāgena medhayā /
tatra gatvāvatiṣṭhante yāvad ābhūtasaṃplavam //
meaning:
तपसा ब्रह्मचर्येण सङ्गत्यागेन मेधया /
तत्र गत्वावतिष्ठन्ते यावद् आभूतसंप्लवम् //
text_mt: Through austerity, celibate studenthood, abandonment of attachment, and wisdom, / having gone there, they remain until the dissolution of the elements.

sanskrit_iast:
yato vedāḥ purāṇāni vidyopaniṣadas tathā /
ślokā sūtrāṇi bhāṣyāṇi yac ca kiṃcana vāṅmayam //
meaning:
यतो वेदाः पुराणानि विद्योपनिषदस् तथा /
श्लोका सूत्राणि भाष्याणि यच् च किंचन वाङ्मयम् //
text_mt: From whom [originate] the Vedas, the Purāṇas, the sciences and the Upaniṣads, / verses, aphorisms, commentaries, and whatever speech exists—

sanskrit_iast:
vedānuvacanaṃ yajño brahmacaryaṃ tapo damaḥ /
śraddhopavāsaḥ svātantryam ātmano jñānahetavaḥ //
meaning:
वेदानुवचनं यज्ञो ब्रह्मचर्यं तपो दमः /
श्रद्धोपवासः स्वातन्त्र्यम् आत्मनो ज्ञानहेतवः //
text_mt: the recitation of the Veda, sacrifice, celibate studenthood, austerity, self-control, / faith, fasting, and mastery over oneself are the means of knowing the self.

sanskrit_iast:
sa hy āśramair vijijñāsyaḥ samastair evam eva tu /
draṣṭavyas tv atha mantavyaḥ śrotavyaś ca dvijātibhiḥ //
meaning:
स ह्य् आश्रमैर् विजिज्ञास्यः समस्तैर् एवम् एव तु /
द्रष्टव्यस् त्व् अथ मन्तव्यः श्रोतव्यश् च द्विजातिभिः //
text_mt: He should indeed be sought after in this very manner by all the stages of life; / and he must be seen, contemplated, and heard of by the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
ya enam evaṃ vindanti ya vāraṇyakam āśritāḥ /
upāsate dvijāḥ satyaṃ śraddhayā parayā yutāḥ //
meaning:
य एनम् एवं विन्दन्ति य वारण्यकम् आश्रिताः /
उपासते द्विजाः सत्यं श्रद्धया परया युताः //
text_mt: Those who know him thus, or those forest-dwelling twice-born / who worship the truth endowed with supreme faith—

sanskrit_iast:
kramāt te saṃbhavanty arcir ahaḥ śuklaṃ tathottaram /
ayanaṃ devalokaṃ ca savitāraṃ savaidyutam //
meaning:
क्रमात् ते संभवन्त्य् अर्चिर् अहः शुक्लं तथोत्तरम् /
अयनं देवलोकं च सवितारं सवैद्युतम् //
text_mt: they successively attain the flame, the day, the bright fortnight, the northern / course [of the sun], the realm of the gods, the sun, and the realm of lightning.

sanskrit_iast:
tatas tān puruṣo 'bhyetya mānaso brahmalaukikān /
karoti punarāvṛttis teṣām iha na vidyate //
meaning:
ततस् तान् पुरुषो ऽभ्येत्य मानसो ब्रह्मलौकिकान् /
करोति पुनरावृत्तिस् तेषाम् इह न विद्यते //
text_mt: Then a mind-born person, approaching them, leads them to the realm of Brahmā; / for them, there is no return to this world.

sanskrit_iast:
yajñena tapasā dānair ye hi svargajito narāḥ /
dhūmaṃ niśāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣaṃ dakṣiṇāyanam eva ca //
meaning:
यज्ञेन तपसा दानैर् ये हि स्वर्गजितो नराः /
धूमं निशां कृष्णपक्षं दक्षिणायनम् एव च //
text_mt: Those men, however, who conquer heaven through sacrifice, austerity, and gifts, / successively attain the smoke, the night, the dark fortnight, the southern course [of the sun],

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛlokaṃ candramasaṃ vāyuṃ vṛṣṭiṃ jalaṃ mahīm /
kramāt te saṃbhavantīha punar eva vrajanti ca //
meaning:
पितृलोकं चन्द्रमसं वायुं वृष्टिं जलं महीम् /
क्रमात् ते संभवन्तीह पुनर् एव व्रजन्ति च //
text_mt: the realm of the ancestors, the moon, wind, rain, water, and earth, / and they return again into this world.

sanskrit_iast:
etad yo na vijānāti mārgadvitayam ātmavān /
dandaśūkaḥ pataṅgo vā bhavet kīṭo 'tha vā kṛmiḥ //
meaning:
एतद् यो न विजानाति मार्गद्वितयम् आत्मवान् /
दन्दशूकः पतङ्गो वा भवेत् कीटो ऽथ वा कृमिः //
text_mt: He who, having a self, does not understand this pair of paths / becomes a venomous serpent, a moth, an insect, or a worm.

sanskrit_iast:
ūrusthottānacaraṇaḥ savye nyasyottaraṃ karam /
uttānaṃ kiṃcid unnāmya mukhaṃ viṣṭabhya corasā //
meaning:
ऊरुस्थोत्तानचरणः सव्ये न्यस्योत्तरं करम् /
उत्तानं किंचिद् उन्नाम्य मुखं विष्टभ्य चोरसा //
text_mt: With the upturned foot placed on the thigh, resting the upper hand on the left, / raising the upturned face slightly, and steadying the chin against the chest,

sanskrit_iast:
nimīlitākṣaḥ sattvastho dantair dantān asaṃspṛśan /
tālusthācalajihvaś ca saṃvṛtāsyaḥ suniścalaḥ //
meaning:
निमीलिताक्षः सत्त्वस्थो दन्तैर् दन्तान् असंस्पृशन् /
तालुस्थाचलजिह्वश् च संवृतास्यः सुनिश्चलः //
text_mt: with closed eyes, established in purity, not letting the teeth touch the teeth, / keeping the motionless tongue against the palate, with mouth closed, perfectly still,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃnirudhyendriyagrāmaṃ nātinīcocchritāsanaḥ /
dviguṇaṃ triguṇaṃ vāpi prāṇāyāmam upakramet //
meaning:
संनिरुध्येन्द्रियग्रामं नातिनीचोच्छ्रितासनः /
द्विगुणं त्रिगुणं वापि प्राणायामम् उपक्रमेत् //
text_mt: having restrained the collection of senses, seated on a seat neither too low nor too high, / he should undertake breath control doubled or tripled.

sanskrit_iast:
tato dhyeyaḥ sthito yo 'sau hṛdaye dīpavat prabhuḥ /
dhārayet tatra cātmānaṃ dhāraṇāṃ dhārayan budhaḥ //
meaning:
ततो ध्येयः स्थितो यो ऽसौ हृदये दीपवत् प्रभुः /
धारयेत् तत्र चात्मानं धारणां धारयन् बुधः //
text_mt: Then the Lord, who dwells like a lamp in the heart, should be meditated upon; / and fixing the mind there, the wise man should practice concentration.

sanskrit_iast:
antardhānaṃ smṛtiḥ kāntir dṛṣṭiḥ śrotrajñatā tathā /
nijaṃ śarīram utsṛjya parakāyapraveśanam //
meaning:
अन्तर्धानं स्मृतिः कान्तिर् दृष्टिः श्रोत्रज्ञता तथा /
निजं शरीरम् उत्सृज्य परकायप्रवेशनम् //
text_mt: Invisibility, memory, beauty, clairvoyance, clairaudience, / abandoning one's own body and entering another's body,

sanskrit_iast:
arthānāṃ chandataḥ sṛṣṭir yogasiddher hi lakṣaṇam /
siddhe yoge tyajan deham amṛtatvāya kalpate //
meaning:
अर्थानां छन्दतः सृष्टिर् योगसिद्धेर् हि लक्षणम् /
सिद्धे योगे त्यजन् देहम् अमृतत्वाय कल्पते //
text_mt: and the creation of objects at will are indeed the marks of the perfection of yoga; / when yoga is perfected, one who casts off the body is fit for immortality.

sanskrit_iast:
atha vāpy abhyasan vedaṃ nyastakarmā vane vasan /
ayācitāśī mitabhuk parāṃ siddhim avāpnuyāt //
meaning:
अथ वाप्य् अभ्यसन् वेदं न्यस्तकर्मा वने वसन् /
अयाचिताशी मितभुक् परां सिद्धिम् अवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: Or rather, practicing the Veda, having cast off rites, dwelling in the forest, / eating unbegged food, and eating in moderation, he may attain supreme perfection.

sanskrit_iast:
nyāyāgatadhanas tattvajñānaniṣṭho 'tithipriyaḥ /
śrādhakṛt satyavādī ca gṛhastho 'pi hi mucyate //
meaning:
न्यायागतधनस् तत्त्वज्ञाननिष्ठो ऽतिथिप्रियः /
श्राधकृत् सत्यवादी च गृहस्थो ऽपि हि मुच्यते //
text_mt: One whose wealth is acquired righteously, devoted to knowledge of the truth, fond of guests, / performing ancestral rites, and speaking the truth—even a householder is liberated.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāpātakajān ghorān narakān prāpya dāruṇān /
karmakṣayāt prajāyante mahāpātakinas tv iha //
meaning:
महापातकजान् घोरान् नरकान् प्राप्य दारुणान् /
कर्मक्षयात् प्रजायन्ते महापातकिनस् त्व् इह //
text_mt: Having reached the dreadful, severe hells born of mortal sins, / perpetrators of mortal sins are reborn here upon the exhaustion of their action.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛgāśvasūkaroṣṭrāṇāṃ brahmahā yonim ṛcchati /
kharapulkasavenānāṃ surāpo nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
मृगाश्वसूकरोष्ट्राणां ब्रह्महा योनिम् ऋच्छति /
खरपुल्कसवेनानां सुरापो नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: The killer of a Brahmin enters the womb of a deer, horse, boar, or camel; / a drinker of liquor [enters the womb] of a donkey, a Pulkasa, or a Vena, without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛmikīṭapataṅgatvaṃ svarṇahārī samāpnuyāt /
tṛṇagulmalatātvaṃ ca kramaśo gurutalpagaḥ //
meaning:
कृमिकीटपतङ्गत्वं स्वर्णहारी समाप्नुयात् /
तृणगुल्मलतात्वं च क्रमशो गुरुतल्पगः //
text_mt:
The stealer of gold attains the condition of a worm, an insect, or a moth,
and the violator of the guru's bed gradually attains the condition of grass, a bush, or a creeper.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmahā kṣayarogī syāt surāpaḥ śyāvadantakaḥ /
hemahārī tu kunakhī duścarmā gurutalpagaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्महा क्षयरोगी स्यात् सुरापः श्यावदन्तकः /
हेमहारी तु कुनखी दुश्चर्मा गुरुतल्पगः //
text_mt:
The killer of a Brahmin becomes consumptive; the drinker of liquor, black-toothed;
the stealer of gold, foul-nailed; and the violator of the guru's bed, diseased in the skin.

sanskrit_iast:
yo yena saṃvasaty eṣāṃ sa talliṅgo 'bhijāyate /
annahartāmayāvī syān mūko vāgapahārakaḥ //
meaning:
यो येन संवसत्य् एषां स तल्लिङ्गो ऽभिजायते /
अन्नहर्तामयावी स्यान् मूको वागपहारकः //
text_mt:
Whoever associates with any of these is born with that person's mark.
The stealer of food becomes sickly; the stealer of speech, mute.

sanskrit_iast:
dhānyamiśro 'tiriktāñgaḥ piśunaḥ pūtināsikaḥ /
tailahṛt tailapāyī syāt pūtivaktras tu sūcakaḥ //
meaning:
धान्यमिश्रो ऽतिरिक्ताञ्गः पिशुनः पूतिनासिकः /
तैलहृत् तैलपायी स्यात् पूतिवक्त्रस् तु सूचकः //
text_mt:
The mixer of grains becomes possessed of a redundant limb; the slanderer, foul-nosed;
the stealer of oil becomes a cockroach; and the informer, foul-mouthed.

sanskrit_iast:
parasya yoṣitaṃ hṛtvā brahmasvam apahṛtya ca /
araṇye nirjale deśe bhavati brahmarākṣasaḥ //
meaning:
परस्य योषितं हृत्वा ब्रह्मस्वम् अपहृत्य च /
अरण्ये निर्जले देशे भवति ब्रह्मराक्षसः //
text_mt:
Having seized another's wife, and having stolen a Brahmin's property,
one becomes a Brahmarākṣasa in a waterless wilderness.

sanskrit_iast:
hīnajātau prajāyeta pararatnāpahārakaḥ /
patraśākaṃ śikhī hatvā gandhān chucchundarī śubhān //
meaning:
हीनजातौ प्रजायेत पररत्नापहारकः /
पत्रशाकं शिखी हत्वा गन्धान् छुच्छुन्दरी शुभान् //
text_mt:
The stealer of another's gems is born in a low caste;
having stolen leafy vegetables, a peacock; [having stolen] pleasant perfumes, a musk-rat.

sanskrit_iast:
mūṣako dhānyahārī syād yānam uṣṭraḥ kapiḥ phalam /
jalaṃ plavaḥ payaḥ kāko gṛhakārī hy upaskaram //
meaning:
मूषको धान्यहारी स्याद् यानम् उष्ट्रः कपिः फलम् /
जलं प्लवः पयः काको गृहकारी ह्य् उपस्करम् //
text_mt:
A stealer of grain becomes a mouse; of a vehicle, a camel; [of] fruit, a monkey;
[of] water, a diving bird; [of] milk, a crow; and [of] household furnishings, a wasp.

sanskrit_iast:
madhu daṃśaḥ palaṃ gṛdhro gāṃ godhāgniṃ bakas tathā /
śvitrī vastraṃ śvā rasaṃ tu cīrī lavaṇahārakaḥ //
meaning:
मधु दंशः पलं गृध्रो गां गोधाग्निं बकस् तथा /
श्वित्री वस्त्रं श्वा रसं तु चीरी लवणहारकः //
text_mt:
[A stealer of] honey becomes a gadfly; of meat, a vulture; of a cow, an iguana; and of fire, a heron;
[a stealer of] clothing becomes a leper; of flavored liquid, a dog; and the stealer of salt, a cricket.

sanskrit_iast:
pradarśanārtham etat tu mayoktaṃ steyakarmaṇi /
dravyaprakārā hi yathā tathaiva prāṇijātayaḥ //
meaning:
प्रदर्शनार्थम् एतत् तु मयोक्तं स्तेयकर्मणि /
द्रव्यप्रकारा हि यथा तथैव प्राणिजातयः //
text_mt:
This has been stated by me only by way of illustration in the matter of theft;
for just as there are types of objects, so indeed are the species of living beings.

sanskrit_iast:
yathākarma phalaṃ prāpya tiryaktvaṃ kālaparyayāt /
jāyante lakṣaṇabhraṣṭā daridrāḥ puruṣādhamāḥ //
meaning:
यथाकर्म फलं प्राप्य तिर्यक्त्वं कालपर्ययात् /
जायन्ते लक्षणभ्रष्टा दरिद्राः पुरुषाधमाः //
text_mt:
Having obtained the fruit according to their deeds in the animal state through the lapse of time,
the lowest of men are born destitute, devoid of auspicious bodily marks.

sanskrit_iast:
tato niṣkalmaṣībhūtāḥ kule mahati bhoginaḥ /
jāyante vidyayopetā dhanadhānyasamanvitāḥ //
meaning:
ततो निष्कल्मषीभूताः कुले महति भोगिनः /
जायन्ते विद्ययोपेता धनधान्यसमन्विताः //
text_mt:
Then, having become free of taint, they are born into a great family as men of enjoyment,
endowed with learning, and provided with wealth and grain.

sanskrit_iast:
vihitasyānanuṣṭhānān ninditasya ca sevanāt /
anigrahāc cendriyāṇāṃ naraḥ patanam ṛcchati //
meaning:
विहितस्याननुष्ठानान् निन्दितस्य च सेवनात् /
अनिग्रहाच् चेन्द्रियाणां नरः पतनम् ऋच्छति //
text_mt:
From not performing what is ordained, and from resorting to what is condemned,
and from the non-restraint of the senses, a man incurs a fall [into sin].

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt teneha kartavyaṃ prāyaścittaṃ viśuddhaye /
evam asyāntarātmā ca lokaś caiva prasīdati //
meaning:
तस्मात् तेनेह कर्तव्यं प्रायश्चित्तं विशुद्धये /
एवम् अस्यान्तरात्मा च लोकश् चैव प्रसीदति //
text_mt:
Therefore, penance must be performed here by him for purification;
thus both his inner self and the world are pleased.

sanskrit_iast:
prāyaścittam akurvāṇāḥ pāpeṣu niratā narāḥ /
apaścāttāpinaḥ kaṣṭān narakān yānti dāruṇān //
meaning:
प्रायश्चित्तम् अकुर्वाणाः पापेषु निरता नराः /
अपश्चात्तापिनः कष्टान् नरकान् यान्ति दारुणान् //
text_mt:
Men who do not perform penance, who are devoted to sins,
and without remorse, go to painful, terrible hells:

sanskrit_iast:
tāmisraṃ lohaśaṅkuṃ ca mahānirayaśālmalī /
rauravaṃ kuḍmalaṃ pūtimṛttikaṃ kālasūtrakam //
meaning:
तामिस्रं लोहशङ्कुं च महानिरयशाल्मली /
रौरवं कुड्मलं पूतिमृत्तिकं कालसूत्रकम् //
text_mt:
Tāmisra, Lohaśaṅku, Mahāniraya, Śālmalī,
Raurava, Kuḍmala, Pūtimṛttika, Kālasūtra,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃghātaṃ lohitodaṃ ca saviṣaṃ saṃprapātanam /
mahānarakakākolaṃ saṃjīvanamahāpatham //
meaning:
संघातं लोहितोदं च सविषं संप्रपातनम् /
महानरककाकोलं संजीवनमहापथम् //
text_mt:
Saṃghāta, Lohitoda, Saviṣa, Saṃprapātana,
Mahānaraka, Kākola, Saṃjīvana, Mahāpatha,

sanskrit_iast:
avīcim andhatāmisraṃ kumbhīpākaṃ tathaiva ca /
asipatravanaṃ caiva tāpanaṃ caikaviṃśakam //
meaning:
अवीचिम् अन्धतामिस्रं कुम्भीपाकं तथैव च /
असिपत्रवनं चैव तापनं चैकविंशकम् //
text_mt:
Avīci, Andhatāmisra, and likewise Kumbhīpāka,
Asipatravana, and Tāpana as the twenty-first.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāpātakajair ghorair upapātakajais tathā /
anvitā yānty acaritaprāyaścittā narādhamāḥ //
meaning:
महापातकजैर् घोरैर् उपपातकजैस् तथा /
अन्विता यान्त्य् अचरितप्रायश्चित्ता नराधमाः //
text_mt:
Attended by terrible [sins] born of major sins, and likewise born of minor sins,
the lowest of men who have not performed penance go [to these hells].

sanskrit_iast:
prāyaścittair apaity eno yad ajñānakṛtaṃ bhavet /
kāmato vyavahāryas tu vacanād iha jāyate //
meaning:
प्रायश्चित्तैर् अपैत्य् एनो यद् अज्ञानकृतं भवेत् /
कामतो व्यवहार्यस् तु वचनाद् इह जायते //
text_mt:
Guilt that was committed through ignorance departs through penances;
but [when done] intentionally, one becomes fit to associate with in this world only by scriptural declaration.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmahā madyapaḥ stenas tathaiva gurutalpagaḥ /
ete mahāpātakino yaś ca taiḥ saha saṃvaset //
meaning:
ब्रह्महा मद्यपः स्तेनस् तथैव गुरुतल्पगः /
एते महापातकिनो यश् च तैः सह संवसेत् //
text_mt:
A killer of a Brahmin, a drinker of liquor, a thief, and likewise a violator of the guru's bed:
these are major sinners, as is whoever associates with them.

sanskrit_iast:
gurūṇām adhyadhikṣepo vedanindā suhṛdvadhaḥ /
brahmahatyāsamaṃ jñeyam adhītasya ca nāśanam //
meaning:
गुरूणाम् अध्यधिक्षेपो वेदनिन्दा सुहृद्वधः /
ब्रह्महत्यासमं ज्ञेयम् अधीतस्य च नाशनम् //
text_mt:
Excessive reviling of gurus, censure of the Veda, slaying a friend,
and destruction of what has been studied are to be known as equal to slaying a Brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
niṣiddhabhakṣaṇaṃ jaihmyam utkarṣe ca vaco 'nṛtam /
rajasvalāmukhāsvādaḥ surāpānasamāni tu //
meaning:
निषिद्धभक्षणं जैह्म्यम् उत्कर्षे च वचो ऽनृतम् /
रजस्वलामुखास्वादः सुरापानसमानि तु //
text_mt:
Eating forbidden food, crookedness, false speech in asserting superiority,
and tasting the mouth of a menstruating woman are equal to drinking liquor.

sanskrit_iast:
aśvaratnamanuṣyastrībhūdhenuharaṇaṃ tathā /
nikṣepasya ca sarvaṃ hi suvarṇasteyasammitam //
meaning:
अश्वरत्नमनुष्यस्त्रीभूधेनुहरणं तथा /
निक्षेपस्य च सर्वं हि सुवर्णस्तेयसम्मितम् //
text_mt:
The theft of a horse, a gem, a man, a woman, land, a cow,
and of a deposit is indeed entirely equal to the theft of gold.

sanskrit_iast:
sakhibhāryākumārīṣu svayoniṣv antyajāsu ca /
sagotrāsu sutantrīṣu gurutalpasamaṃ smṛtam //
meaning:
सखिभार्याकुमारीषु स्वयोनिष्व् अन्त्यजासु च /
सगोत्रासु सुतन्त्रीषु गुरुतल्पसमं स्मृतम् //
text_mt:
[Sexual intercourse] with a friend's wife, a maiden, one's own female relatives, lowest-caste women,
women of the same gotra, and wives of a son is traditionally regarded as equal to violating the guru's bed.

sanskrit_iast:
pituḥ svasāraṃ mātuś ca matulānīṃ snuṣām api /
mātuḥ sapatnīṃ bhaginīm ācāryatanayāṃ tathā //
meaning:
पितुः स्वसारं मातुश् च मतुलानीं स्नुषाम् अपि /
मातुः सपत्नीं भगिनीम् आचार्यतनयां तथा //
text_mt:
Approaching the father's sister, the mother's sister, the maternal uncle's wife, the daughter-in-law,
the father's co-wife, a sister, the teacher's daughter,

sanskrit_iast:
ācāryapatnīṃ svasutāṃ gacchaṃs tu gurutalpagaḥ /
liṅgaṃ chittvā vadhas tasya sakāmāyāḥ striyā api //
meaning:
आचार्यपत्नीं स्वसुतां गच्छंस् तु गुरुतल्पगः /
लिङ्गं छित्त्वा वधस् तस्य सकामायाः स्त्रिया अपि //
text_mt:
the teacher's wife, or one's own daughter, one is a violator of the guru's bed.
His punishment is having cut off his penis; and also of the woman, if she was consenting.

sanskrit_iast:
govadho vrātyatā steyam ṛṇānāṃ cānapākriyā /
anāhitāgnitāpaṇyavikrayaḥ paridevanam //
meaning:
गोवधो व्रात्यता स्तेयम् ऋणानां चानपाक्रिया /
अनाहिताग्नितापण्यविक्रयः परिदेवनम् //
text_mt:
Killing a cow, outcaste status, theft, non-payment of debts,
not maintaining the sacred fires, sale of forbidden commodities, lamentation,

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛtād adhyayanādānaṃ bhṛtakādhyāpanaṃ tathā /
pāradāryaṃ pārivittyaṃ vārdhuṣyaṃ lavaṇakriyā //
meaning:
भृताद् अध्ययनादानं भृतकाध्यापनं तथा /
पारदार्यं पारिवित्त्यं वार्धुष्यं लवणक्रिया //
text_mt:
taking study from a hired teacher, teaching for hire,
adultery, marriage before an elder brother, usury, manufacture of salt,

sanskrit_iast:
strīśūdraviṭkṣatravadho ninditārthopajīvanam /
nāstikyaṃ vratalopaś ca sutānāṃ caiva vikrayaḥ //
meaning:
स्त्रीशूद्रविट्क्षत्रवधो निन्दितार्थोपजीवनम् /
नास्तिक्यं व्रतलोपश् च सुतानां चैव विक्रयः //
text_mt:
slaying a woman, a Shudra, a Vaishya, or a Kshatriya, living by censured means,
atheism, breaking a vow, and selling one's sons,

sanskrit_iast:
dhānyakupyapaśusteyam ayājyānāṃ ca yājanam /
pitṛmātṛsutatyāgas taḍāgārāmavikrayaḥ //
meaning:
धान्यकुप्यपशुस्तेयम् अयाज्यानां च याजनम् /
पितृमातृसुतत्यागस् तडागारामविक्रयः //
text_mt:
theft of grain, base metal, or cattle, performing sacrifices for those unfit to sacrifice,
abandoning father, mother, or son, sale of a pond or a garden,

sanskrit_iast:
kanyāsaṃdūṣaṇaṃ caiva parivindakayājanam /
kanyāpradānaṃ tasyaiva kauṭilyaṃ vratalopanam //
meaning:
कन्यासंदूषणं चैव परिविन्दकयाजनम् /
कन्याप्रदानं तस्यैव कौटिल्यं व्रतलोपनम् //
text_mt:
defiling a maiden, performing sacrifices for one married before his elder brother,
giving a maiden to him, crookedness, breaking a vow,

sanskrit_iast:
ātmano 'rthe kriyārambho madyapastrīniṣevaṇam /
svādhyāyāgnisutatyāgo bāndhavatyāga eva ca //
meaning:
आत्मनो ऽर्थे क्रियारम्भो मद्यपस्त्रीनिषेवणम् /
स्वाध्यायाग्निसुतत्यागो बान्धवत्याग एव च //
text_mt:
undertaking rites for one's own sake, resorting to a woman who drinks liquor,
abandoning recitation of the Veda, sacred fires, or a son, and abandoning relatives,

sanskrit_iast:
indhanārthaṃ drumachedaḥ strīhiṃsāuṣadhajīvanam /
hiṃsrayantravidhānaṃ ca vyasanāny ātmavikrayaḥ //
meaning:
इन्धनार्थं द्रुमछेदः स्त्रीहिंसाउषधजीवनम् /
हिंस्रयन्त्रविधानं च व्यसनान्य् आत्मविक्रयः //
text_mt:
cutting trees for firewood, harming women, living by medicines,
setting up destructive mechanical contrivances, addictions, selling oneself,

sanskrit_iast:
śūdrapreṣyaṃ hīnasakhyaṃ hīnayoniniṣevaṇam /
tathaivānāśrame vāsaḥ parānnaparipuṣṭatā //
meaning:
शूद्रप्रेष्यं हीनसख्यं हीनयोनिनिषेवणम् /
तथैवानाश्रमे वासः परान्नपरिपुष्टता //
text_mt:
servitude to a Shudra, friendship with base persons, intercourse with women of low birth,
likewise living outside the stages of life, and being nourished on another's food,

sanskrit_iast:
asacchāstrādhigamanam ākareṣv adhikāritā /
bhāryāyā vikrayaś caiṣām ekaikam upapātakam //
meaning:
असच्छास्त्राधिगमनम् आकरेष्व् अधिकारिता /
भार्याया विक्रयश् चैषाम् एकैकम् उपपातकम् //
text_mt:
studying uncanonical treatises, holding authority over mines,
and selling one's wife: each one of these is a minor sin.

sanskrit_iast:
śiraḥkapālī dhvajavān bhikṣāśī karma vedayan /
brahmahā dvādaśābdāni mitabhuk śuddhim āpnuyāt //
meaning:
शिरःकपाली ध्वजवान् भिक्षाशी कर्म वेदयन् /
ब्रह्महा द्वादशाब्दानि मितभुक् शुद्धिम् आप्नुयात् //
text_mt:
Carrying a skull, bearing a staff, eating alms-food, proclaiming his deed,
[and] eating moderately, the killer of a Brahmin would attain purification in twelve years.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇasya paritrāṇād gavāṃ dvādaśakasya ca /
tathāśvamedhāvabhṛthasnānād vā śuddhim āpnuyāt //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणस्य परित्राणाद् गवां द्वादशकस्य च /
तथाश्वमेधावभृथस्नानाद् वा शुद्धिम् आप्नुयात् //
text_mt:
Or through the rescue of a Brahmin and of twelve cows,
or through the concluding ablution bath of a horse sacrifice, he would attain purification.

sanskrit_iast:
dīrghatīvrāmayagrastaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ gām athāpi vā /
dṛṣṭvā pathi nirātaṅkaṃ kṛtvā tu brahmahā śuciḥ //
meaning:
दीर्घतीव्रामयग्रस्तं ब्राह्मणं गाम् अथापि वा /
दृष्ट्वा पथि निरातङ्कं कृत्वा तु ब्रह्महा शुचिः //
text_mt:
Or having seen a Brahmin or a cow on the road afflicted by a long and severe disease,
and having relieved them of suffering, the killer of a Brahmin becomes pure.

sanskrit_iast:
ānīya viprasarvasvaṃ hṛtaṃ ghātita eva vā /
tannimittaṃ kṣataḥ śastrair jīvann api viśudhyati //
meaning:
आनीय विप्रसर्वस्वं हृतं घातित एव वा /
तन्निमित्तं क्षतः शस्त्रैर् जीवन्न् अपि विशुध्यति //
text_mt:
Having recovered a Brahmin's property that was stolen, or [if] he was killed
for that purpose, even if wounded by weapons while surviving, he is purified.

sanskrit_iast:
lomabhyaḥ svāhety evaṃ hi lomaprabhṛti vai tanum /
majjāntāṃ juhuyād vāpi mantrair ebhir yathākramam //
meaning:
लोमभ्यः स्वाहेत्य् एवं हि लोमप्रभृति वै तनुम् /
मज्जान्तां जुहुयाद् वापि मन्त्रैर् एभिर् यथाक्रमम् //
text_mt:
Or he should offer his body into the fire with the mantras, 'Svāhā to the hairs,'
beginning with the hairs and ending with the marrow, in due order.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃgrāme vā hato lakṣyabhūtaḥ śuddhim avāpnuyāt /
mṛtakalpaḥ prahārārto jīvann api viśudhyati //
meaning:
संग्रामे वा हतो लक्ष्यभूतः शुद्धिम् अवाप्नुयात् /
मृतकल्पः प्रहारार्तो जीवन्न् अपि विशुध्यति //
text_mt:
Or having been slain in battle as a target, he would attain purification;
[or] having been reduced to a near-dead state, afflicted with wounds, he is purified even while living.

sanskrit_iast:
araṇye niyato japtvā trir vai vedasya saṃhitām /
śudhyeta vā mitāśitvāt pratisrotaḥ sarasvatīm //
meaning:
अरण्ये नियतो जप्त्वा त्रिर् वै वेदस्य संहिताम् /
शुध्येत वा मिताशित्वात् प्रतिस्रोतः सरस्वतीम् //
text_mt:
Restrained in a forest, having recited the Saṃhitā of the Veda three times,
or by eating moderately [while walking] against the current of the Sarasvatī, he would be purified.

sanskrit_iast:
pātre dhanaṃ vā paryāptaṃ dattvā śuddhim avāpnuyāt /
ādātuś ca viśuddhyartham iṣṭair vaiśvānarī smṛtā //
meaning:
पात्रे धनं वा पर्याप्तं दत्त्वा शुद्धिम् अवाप्नुयात् /
आदातुश् च विशुद्ध्यर्थम् इष्टैर् वैश्वानरी स्मृता //
text_mt:
Or having given adequate wealth to a worthy recipient, he would attain purification;
and for the purification of the receiver, a Vaiśvānarī rite is prescribed.

sanskrit_iast:
yāgasthakṣatraviḍghātī cared brahmahaṇi vratam /
garbhahā ca yathāvarṇaṃ tathātreyīniṣūdakaḥ //
meaning:
यागस्थक्षत्रविड्घाती चरेद् ब्रह्महणि व्रतम् /
गर्भहा च यथावर्णं तथात्रेयीनिषूदकः //
text_mt:
One who slays a Kshatriya or a Vaishya engaged in a sacrifice should perform the vow for slaying a Brahmin;
also one who slays an embryo according to the social class, and likewise a slayer of a woman who has bathed after her courses.

sanskrit_iast:
cared vratam ahatvāpi ghātārthaṃ cet samāgataḥ /
dviguṇaṃ savanasthe tu brāhmaṇe vratam ādiśet //
meaning:
चरेद् व्रतम् अहत्वापि घातार्थं चेत् समागतः /
द्विगुणं सवनस्थे तु ब्राह्मणे व्रतम् आदिशेत् //
text_mt:
He should perform the vow even without having killed, if he came for the purpose of killing;
but one should prescribe a double vow in the case of a Brahmin engaged in the soma pressing.

sanskrit_iast:
surāmbughṛtagomūtrapayasām agnisaṃnibham /
surāpo 'nyatamaṃ pītvā maraṇāc chuddhim ṛcchati //
meaning:
सुराम्बुघृतगोमूत्रपयसाम् अग्निसंनिभम् /
सुरापो ऽन्यतमं पीत्वा मरणाच् छुद्धिम् ऋच्छति //
text_mt:
Having drunk any one of liquor, water, clarified butter, cow's urine, or milk,
resembling fire, the drinker of liquor attains purification through death.

sanskrit_iast:
vālavāsā jaṭī vāpi brahmahatyāvrataṃ caret /
piṇyākaṃ vā kaṇān vāpi bhakṣayet trisamā niśi //
meaning:
वालवासा जटी वापि ब्रह्महत्याव्रतं चरेत् /
पिण्याकं वा कणान् वापि भक्षयेत् त्रिसमा निशि //
text_mt:
Or clad in horsehair garments, or wearing matted hair, he should perform the vow for slaying a Brahmin,
or he should eat oil-cake or broken grains at night for three years.

sanskrit_iast:
ajñānāt tu surāṃ pītvā reto viṇmūtram eva ca /
punaḥ saṃskāram arhanti trayo varṇā dvijātayaḥ //
meaning:
अज्ञानात् तु सुरां पीत्वा रेतो विण्मूत्रम् एव च /
पुनः संस्कारम् अर्हन्ति त्रयो वर्णा द्विजातयः //
text_mt:
Having drunk liquor unwittingly, or semen, feces, or urine,
the three twice-born social classes deserve to undergo the life-cycle rite once again.

sanskrit_iast:
patilokaṃ na sā yāti brāhmaṇī yā surāṃ pibet /
ihaiva sā śunī gṛdhrī sūkarī copajāyate //
meaning:
पतिलोकं न सा याति ब्राह्मणी या सुरां पिबेत् /
इहैव सा शुनी गृध्री सूकरी चोपजायते //
text_mt: The Brahmin woman who drinks liquor does not attain her husband's world; / in this very world she is reborn as a female dog, a female vulture, or a sow.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇasvarṇahārī tu rājñe musalam arpayet /
svakarma vyākhyāyaṃs tena hato mukto 'pi vāśuciḥ //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणस्वर्णहारी तु राज्ञे मुसलम् अर्पयेत् /
स्वकर्म व्याख्यायंस् तेन हतो मुक्तो ऽपि वाशुचिः //
text_mt: A stealer of Brahmin gold, however, should offer an iron pestle to the king, / declaring his deed; killed or released by him, he becomes purified.

sanskrit_iast:
anivedya nṛpe śudhyet surāpavratam ācaran /
ātmatulyaṃ suvarṇaṃ vā dadyād vā vipratuṣṭikṛt //
meaning:
अनिवेद्य नृपे शुध्येत् सुरापव्रतम् आचरन् /
आत्मतुल्यं सुवर्णं वा दद्याद् वा विप्रतुष्टिकृत् //
text_mt: Without reporting [it] to the king, he becomes purified by observing the vow of a liquor-drinker, / or he should give gold equal [in weight] to himself, or pleasing Brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
tapte 'yaḥśayane sārdham āyasyā yoṣitā svapet /
gṛhītvotkṛttya vṛṣaṇau nairṛtyāṃ cotsṛjet tanum //
meaning:
तप्ते ऽयःशयने सार्धम् आयस्या योषिता स्वपेत् /
गृहीत्वोत्कृत्त्य वृषणौ नैरृत्यां चोत्सृजेत् तनुम् //
text_mt: He should sleep on a heated iron bed together with an iron woman, / [or] seizing and cutting off his testicles, he should cast off his body towards the southwest.

sanskrit_iast:
prājāpatyaṃ caret kṛcchraṃ samā vā gurutalpagaḥ /
cāndrāyaṇaṃ vā trīn māsān abhyased vedasaṃhitām //
meaning:
प्राजापत्यं चरेत् कृच्छ्रं समा वा गुरुतल्पगः /
चान्द्रायणं वा त्रीन् मासान् अभ्यसेद् वेदसंहिताम् //
text_mt: Or, one who violates the guru's bed should observe a Prājāpatya penance for a year, / or a lunar penance for three months, [and] practice the Vedic Saṃhitā.

sanskrit_iast:
ebhis tu saṃvased yo vai vatsaraṃ so 'pi tatsamaḥ /
kanyāṃ samudvahed eṣāṃ sopavāsām akiṃcanām //
meaning:
एभिस् तु संवसेद् यो वै वत्सरं सो ऽपि तत्समः /
कन्यां समुद्वहेद् एषां सोपवासाम् अकिंचनाम् //
text_mt: Whoever resides with these [sinners] for a year becomes equal to them. / One should marry a maiden of theirs who fasts and has no possessions.

sanskrit_iast:
cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret sarvān avakṛṣṭān nihatya tu /
śūdro 'dhikārahīnopi kālenānena śudhyati //
meaning:
चान्द्रायणं चरेत् सर्वान् अवकृष्टान् निहत्य तु /
शूद्रो ऽधिकारहीनोपि कालेनानेन शुध्यति //
text_mt: One should perform a lunar penance having slain any inferior person; / even a Shudra devoid of religious competence is purified by this duration of time.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcagavyaṃ pibed goghno māsam āsīta saṃyataḥ /
goṣṭheśayo go'nugāmī gopradānena śudhyati //
meaning:
पञ्चगव्यं पिबेद् गोघ्नो मासम् आसीत संयतः /
गोष्ठेशयो गोऽनुगामी गोप्रदानेन शुध्यति //
text_mt: A cow-killer should drink the five products of a cow and sit self-controlled for a month, / sleeping in a cowshed, following cows; he is purified by the gift of a cow.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛcchraṃ caivātikṛcchraṃ ca cared vāpi samāhitaḥ /
dadyāt trirātraṃ copoṣya vṛṣabhaikādaśās tu gāḥ //
meaning:
कृच्छ्रं चैवातिकृच्छ्रं च चरेद् वापि समाहितः /
दद्यात् त्रिरात्रं चोपोष्य वृषभैकादशास् तु गाः //
text_mt: Or, composed in mind, he should observe a penitential hardship and a severe kṛcchra penance, / and having fasted for three nights, he should give cows with a bull as the eleventh.

sanskrit_iast:
upapātakaśuddhiḥ syād evaṃ cāndrāyaṇena vā /
payasā vāpi māsena parākeṇātha vā punaḥ //
meaning:
उपपातकशुद्धिः स्याद् एवं चान्द्रायणेन वा /
पयसा वापि मासेन पराकेणाथ वा पुनः //
text_mt: Purification from a secondary sin can be achieved in this manner, or through a lunar penance, / or through milk for a month, or again by a Parāka fast.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣabhaikasahasrā gā dadyāt kṣatravadhe pumān /
brahmahatyāvrataṃ vāpi vatsaratritayaṃ caret //
meaning:
ऋषभैकसहस्रा गा दद्यात् क्षत्रवधे पुमान् /
ब्रह्महत्याव्रतं वापि वत्सरत्रितयं चरेत् //
text_mt: For killing a Kshatriya, a man should give one thousand cows with one bull, / or he should observe the vow for killing a Brahmin for three years.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśyahābdaṃ cared etad dadyād vaikaśataṃ gavām /
ṣaṇmāsāc chūdrahāpy etad dhenur dadyād daśātha vā //
meaning:
वैश्यहाब्दं चरेद् एतद् दद्याद् वैकशतं गवाम् /
षण्मासाच् छूद्रहाप्य् एतद् धेनुर् दद्याद् दशाथ वा //
text_mt: The killer of a Vaishya should observe this for a year, or give one hundred and one cows; / the killer of a Shudra should do this for six months, or give ten milch cows.

sanskrit_iast:
durvṛttabrahmaviṭkṣatraśūdrayoṣāḥ pramāpya tu /
dṛtiṃ dhanur bastam aviṃ kramād dadyād viśuddhaye //
meaning:
दुर्वृत्तब्रह्मविट्क्षत्रशूद्रयोषाः प्रमाप्य तु /
दृतिं धनुर् बस्तम् अविं क्रमाद् दद्याद् विशुद्धये //
text_mt: Having killed unchaste women of the Brahmin, Vaishya, Kshatriya, and Shudra [classes], / one should give a leather bag, a bow, a he-goat, and a sheep, in order, for purification.

sanskrit_iast:
apraduṣṭāṃ striyaṃ hatvā śūdrahatyāvrataṃ caret /
asthimatāṃ sahasraṃ tu tathānasthimatām anaḥ //
meaning:
अप्रदुष्टां स्त्रियं हत्वा शूद्रहत्याव्रतं चरेत् /
अस्थिमतां सहस्रं तु तथानस्थिमताम् अनः //
text_mt: Having killed an uncorrupted woman, one should observe the vow for killing a Shudra; / [and for killing] a thousand animals possessing bones, or a cart-load of boneless creatures.

sanskrit_iast:
mārjāragodhānakulamaṇḍūkāṃś ca patatriṇaḥ /
hatvā tryahaṃ pibet kṣīraṃ kṛcchraṃ vā pādikaṃ caret //
meaning:
मार्जारगोधानकुलमण्डूकांश् च पतत्रिणः /
हत्वा त्र्यहं पिबेत् क्षीरं कृच्छ्रं वा पादिकं चरेत् //
text_mt: Having killed a cat, an alligator, a mongoose, frogs, or birds, / one should drink milk for three days, or perform a quarter-kṛcchra.

sanskrit_iast:
gaje nīlavṛṣāḥ pañca śuke vatso dvihāyanaḥ /
kharājameṣeṣu vṛṣo deyaḥ krauñce trihāyanaḥ //
meaning:
गजे नीलवृषाः पञ्च शुके वत्सो द्विहायनः /
खराजमेषेषु वृषो देयः क्रौञ्चे त्रिहायनः //
text_mt: For an elephant, five dark-blue bulls [must be given]; for a parrot, a two-year-old calf; / for an ass, a goat, or a sheep, a bull is to be given; for a heron, a three-year-old [calf];

sanskrit_iast:
haṃsaśyenakapikravyāj jalasthalaśikhaṇḍinaḥ /
bhāsaṃ ca hatvā dadyād gām akravyādas tu vatsikām //
meaning:
हंसश्येनकपिक्रव्याज् जलस्थलशिखण्डिनः /
भासं च हत्वा दद्याद् गाम् अक्रव्यादस् तु वत्सिकाम् //
text_mt: Having killed a swan, a falcon, a monkey, a carnivorous bird, water or land peafowl, / or a vulture, one should give a cow; for a non-carnivorous [bird], a female calf;

sanskrit_iast:
urageṣv āyaso daṇḍaḥ paṇḍake trapu sīsakam /
kole ghṛtaghaṭo deya uṣṭre guñjā haye 'ṃśukam //
meaning:
उरगेष्व् आयसो दण्डः पण्डके त्रपु सीसकम् /
कोले घृतघटो देय उष्ट्रे गुञ्जा हये ऽंशुकम् //
text_mt: For serpents, an iron staff; for a eunuch, tin and lead; / for a boar, a pot of ghee is to be given; for a camel, a guñjā [weight of gold]; for a horse, a cloth;

sanskrit_iast:
tittirau tu tiladroṇaṃ gajādīnām aśaknuvan /
dānaṃ dātuṃ caret kṛcchram ekaikasya viśuddhaye //
meaning:
तित्तिरौ तु तिलद्रोणं गजादीनाम् अशक्नुवन् /
दानं दातुं चरेत् कृच्छ्रम् एकैकस्य विशुद्धये //
text_mt: For a partridge, a droṇa of sesame. Unable to give the gift / for an elephant and the like, one should perform a penitential hardship for the purification of each.

sanskrit_iast:
phalapuṣpānnarasajasattvaghāte ghṛtāśanam /
kiṃcit sāsthivadhe deyaṃ prāṇāyāmas tv anasthike //
meaning:
फलपुष्पान्नरसजसत्त्वघाते घृताशनम् /
किंचित् सास्थिवधे देयं प्राणायामस् त्व् अनस्थिके //
text_mt: Upon killing creatures born from fruits, flowers, food, or juices, eating ghee is [the expiation]; / something should be given for killing a boned animal, but breath control [is required] for a boneless one.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛkṣagulmalatāvīrucchedane japyam ṛkśatam /
syād oṣadhivṛthāchede kṣīrāśī go'nugo dinam //
meaning:
वृक्षगुल्मलतावीरुच्छेदने जप्यम् ऋक्शतम् /
स्याद् ओषधिवृथाछेदे क्षीराशी गोऽनुगो दिनम् //
text_mt: Upon cutting down trees, shrubs, climbing vines, or creeping plants, a hundred ṛk-verses should be muttered; / upon the useless cutting of medicinal plants, [one should be] a milk-drinker following cows for a day.

sanskrit_iast:
puṃścalīvānarakharair daṣṭaśvoṣṭrādivāyasaiḥ /
prāṇāyāmaṃ jale kṛtvā ghṛtaṃ prāśya viśudhyati //
meaning:
पुंश्चलीवानरखरैर् दष्टश्वोष्ट्रादिवायसैः /
प्राणायामं जले कृत्वा घृतं प्राश्य विशुध्यति //
text_mt: Bitten by a harlot, a monkey, an ass, dogs, camels, and the like, or crows, / having performed breath control in water and tasted ghee, one is purified.

sanskrit_iast:
yan me 'dya reta ityābhyāṃ skannaṃ reto 'bhimantrayet /
stanāntaraṃ bhruvor madhyaṃ tenānāmikayā spṛśet //
meaning:
यन् मे ऽद्य रेत इत्याभ्यां स्कन्नं रेतो ऽभिमन्त्रयेत् /
स्तनान्तरं भ्रुवोर् मध्यं तेनानामिकया स्पृशेत् //
text_mt: With the two [mantras beginning with] 'Whatever semen of mine today', he should consecrate the spilled semen; / with that [semen], he should touch the space between his breasts and the space between his eyebrows using the ring finger.

sanskrit_iast:
mayi teja iti chāyāṃ svāṃ dṛṣṭvāmbugatāṃ japet /
sāvitrīm aśucau dṛṣṭe cāpalye cānṛte 'pi ca //
meaning:
मयि तेज इति छायां स्वां दृष्ट्वाम्बुगतां जपेत् /
सावित्रीम् अशुचौ दृष्टे चापल्ये चानृते ऽपि च //
text_mt: Having seen his own reflection cast in water, he should murmur: 'May splendour be in me'; / [he should murmur] the Sāvitrī upon seeing an impurity, in rash conduct, and also upon speaking an untruth.

sanskrit_iast:
avakīrṇī bhaved gatvā brahmacārī tu yoṣitam /
gardabhaṃ paśum ālabhya nairṛtaṃ sa viśudhyati //
meaning:
अवकीर्णी भवेद् गत्वा ब्रह्मचारी तु योषितम् /
गर्दभं पशुम् आलभ्य नैरृतं स विशुध्यति //
text_mt: A chaste student who has sex with a woman becomes one who has broken his vow of celibacy; / having sacrificed a donkey as a victim to Nirṛti, he is purified.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaikṣāgnikārye tyaktvā tu saptarātram anāturaḥ /
kāmāvakīrṇa ity ābhyāṃ juhuyād āhutidvayam //
meaning:
भैक्षाग्निकार्ये त्यक्त्वा तु सप्तरात्रम् अनातुरः /
कामावकीर्ण इत्य् आभ्यां जुहुयाद् आहुतिद्वयम् //
text_mt: Having omitted the collection of alms and the fire rite for seven nights while not ill, / he should offer two oblations with the two [mantras beginning with] 'He who has violated his vow out of desire'.

sanskrit_iast:
upasthānaṃ tataḥ kuryāt saṃ mā siṃcantv anena tu /
madhumāṃsāśane kāryaḥ kṛcchraḥ śeṣavratāni ca //
meaning:
उपस्थानं ततः कुर्यात् सं मा सिंचन्त्व् अनेन तु /
मधुमांसाशने कार्यः कृच्छ्रः शेषव्रतानि च //
text_mt: Then he should perform worship [of the sun] with: 'May they sprinkle me'; / upon eating honey or meat, a penitential hardship must be performed, as well as the remaining vows.

sanskrit_iast:
pratikūlaṃ guroḥ kṛtvā prasādyaiva viśudhyati /
kṛcchratrayaṃ guruḥ kuryān mriyate prahito yadi //
meaning:
प्रतिकूलं गुरोः कृत्वा प्रसाद्यैव विशुध्यति /
कृच्छ्रत्रयं गुरुः कुर्यान् म्रियते प्रहितो यदि //
text_mt: Having acted against the guru, one is purified only by propitiating [him]; / the guru should perform three penitential hardships if [a student] dies when sent on an errand.

sanskrit_iast:
kriyamāṇopakāre tu mṛte vipre na pātakam /
vipāke govṛṣāṇāṃ tu bheṣajāgnikriyāsu ca //
meaning:
क्रियमाणोपकारे तु मृते विप्रे न पातकम् /
विपाके गोवृषाणां तु भेषजाग्निक्रियासु च //
text_mt:
The fault of a false accuser is twice that of one who speaks the truth; / and uttering a lie, he takes on the fault of the falsely accused person.
When a Brahmin dies while a beneficial service is being performed [for him], there is no sin; / nor in the case of cows and bulls during concoction [of medicines], treatment with medicine, and the application of branding.

sanskrit_iast:
mithyābhiśaṃsino doṣo dviḥ samo bhūtavādinaḥ /
mithyābhiśastadoṣaṃ ca samādatte mṛṣā vadan //
meaning:
मिथ्याभिशंसिनो दोषो द्विः समो भूतवादिनः /
मिथ्याभिशस्तदोषं च समादत्ते मृषा वदन् //
text_mt: Whoever falsely accuses another of a major sin or a secondary sin / should subsist on water for a month, murmuring [prayers] with restrained senses.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāpāpopapāpābhyāṃ yo 'bhiśaṃsen mṛṣā param /
abbhakṣo māsam āsīta sa jāpī niyatendriyaḥ //
meaning:
महापापोपपापाभ्यां यो ऽभिशंसेन् मृषा परम् /
अब्भक्षो मासम् आसीत स जापी नियतेन्द्रियः //

sanskrit_iast:
abhiśasto mṛṣā kṛcchraṃ cared āgneyam eva vā /
nirvapet tu puroḍāśaṃ vāyavyaṃ paśum eva vā //
meaning:
अभिशस्तो मृषा कृच्छ्रं चरेद् आग्नेयम् एव वा /
निर्वपेत् तु पुरोडाशं वायव्यं पशुम् एव वा //
text_mt: One who is falsely accused should perform a penitential hardship, or / offer a sacrificial cake to Agni, or an animal victim to Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast:
aniyukto bhrātṛjāyāṃ gacchaṃś cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret /
trirātrānte ghṛtaṃ prāśya gatvodakyāṃ viśudhyati //
meaning:
अनियुक्तो भ्रातृजायां गच्छंश् चान्द्रायणं चरेत् /
त्रिरात्रान्ते घृतं प्राश्य गत्वोदक्यां विशुध्यति //
text_mt: Going to a brother's wife without being commissioned, he should perform a lunar penance; / having had intercourse with a menstruating woman, he is purified after three nights by consuming ghee.

sanskrit_iast:
trīn kṛcchrān ācared vrātyayājako 'bhicarann api /
vedaplāvī yavāśy abdaṃ tyaktvā ca śaraṇāgatam //
meaning:
त्रीन् कृच्छ्रान् आचरेद् व्रात्ययाजको ऽभिचरन्न् अपि /
वेदप्लावी यवाश्य् अब्दं त्यक्त्वा च शरणागतम् //
text_mt: One who sacrifices for an outcaste, or who performs malevolent sorcery, should perform three penitential hardships; / one who repudiates the Veda or abandons one who sought refuge, eating barley for a year [is purified].

sanskrit_iast:
goṣṭhe vasan brahmacārī māsam ekaṃ payovratam /
gāyatrījapyanirataḥ śudhyate 'satpratigrahāt //
meaning:
गोष्ठे वसन् ब्रह्मचारी मासम् एकं पयोव्रतम् /
गायत्रीजप्यनिरतः शुध्यते ऽसत्प्रतिग्रहात् //
text_mt: Dwelling in a cowshed as a celibate student for one month on a milk vow, / devoted to murmuring the Gāyatrī, one is purified from accepting gifts from the unworthy.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇāyāmī jale snātvā kharayānoṣṭrayānagaḥ /
nagnaḥ snātvā ca bhuktvā ca gatvā caiva divā striyam //
meaning:
प्राणायामी जले स्नात्वा खरयानोष्ट्रयानगः /
नग्नः स्नात्वा च भुक्त्वा च गत्वा चैव दिवा स्त्रियम् //
text_mt: One who rides in an ass-cart or a camel-cart, / one who bathes naked, eats naked, or has sex with a woman by day, [is purified] having bathed in water and practiced breath control.

sanskrit_iast:
guruṃ huṃkṛtya tvaṃkṛtya vipraṃ nirjitya vādataḥ /
baddhvā vā vāsasā kṣipraṃ prasādyopavased dinam //
meaning:
गुरुं हुंकृत्य त्वंकृत्य विप्रं निर्जित्य वादतः /
बद्ध्वा वा वाससा क्षिप्रं प्रसाद्योपवसेद् दिनम् //
text_mt: Addressing a guru with 'hum' or 'thou', or having conquered a Brahmin in debate, / or binding him with a cloth, one should fast for a day after promptly appeasing him.

sanskrit_iast:
vipradaṇḍodyame kṛcchras tv atikṛcchro nipātane /
kṛcchrātikṛcchro 'sṛkpāte kṛcchro 'bhyantaraśoṇite //
meaning:
विप्रदण्डोद्यमे कृच्छ्रस् त्व् अतिकृच्छ्रो निपातने /
कृच्छ्रातिकृच्छ्रो ऽसृक्पाते कृच्छ्रो ऽभ्यन्तरशोणिते //
text_mt: For raising a stick against a Brahmin, a penitential hardship [is prescribed], but a severe kṛcchra penance for striking him; / a most severe kṛcchra penance for drawing blood, and a penitential hardship for internal contusion.

sanskrit_iast:
deśaṃ kālaṃ vayaḥ śaktiṃ pāpaṃ cāvekṣya yatnataḥ /
prāyaścittaṃ prakalpyaṃ syād yatra coktā na niṣkṛtiḥ //
meaning:
देशं कालं वयः शक्तिं पापं चावेक्ष्य यत्नतः /
प्रायश्चित्तं प्रकल्प्यं स्याद् यत्र चोक्ता न निष्कृतिः //
text_mt: Considering carefully the place, time, age, capacity, and sin, / an expiation should be determined wherever an atonement has not been stated.

sanskrit_iast:
dāṣīkumbhaṃ bahirgrāmān ninayeran svabāndhavāḥ /
patitasya bahiḥ kuryuḥ sarvakāryeṣu caiva tam //
meaning:
दाषीकुम्भं बहिर्ग्रामान् निनयेरन् स्वबान्धवाः /
पतितस्य बहिः कुर्युः सर्वकार्येषु चैव तम् //
text_mt: His female slave's water jar should be cast out outside the village by his relatives, / and they should exclude that fallen person from all religious acts.

sanskrit_iast:
caritavrata āyāte ninayeran navaṃ ghaṭam /
jugupseran na cāpy enaṃ saṃvaseyuś ca sarvaśaḥ //
meaning:
चरितव्रत आयाते निनयेरन् नवं घटम् /
जुगुप्सेरन् न चाप्य् एनं संवसेयुश् च सर्वशः //
text_mt: When he returns having performed the vow, they should bring a new jar; / and they should not despise him, and they should associate with him in every way.

sanskrit_iast:
patitānām eṣa eva vidhiḥ strīṇāṃ prakīrtitaḥ /
vāso gṛhāntake deyam annaṃ vāsaḥ sarakṣaṇam //
meaning:
पतितानाम् एष एव विधिः स्त्रीणां प्रकीर्तितः /
वासो गृहान्तके देयम् अन्नं वासः सरक्षणम् //
text_mt: This very rule has been declared for fallen women: / dwelling near the house should be given [to her], food, clothing, along with protection.

sanskrit_iast:
nīcābhigamanaṃ garbhapātanaṃ bhartṛhiṃsanam /
viśeṣapatanīyāni strīmām etāny api dhruvam //
meaning:
नीचाभिगमनं गर्भपातनं भर्तृहिंसनम् /
विशेषपतनीयानि स्त्रीमाम् एतान्य् अपि ध्रुवम् //
text_mt: Intercourse with a base-born man, abortion, and injury to the husband: / these are indeed causes of outcasting especially for women.

sanskrit_iast:
śaraṇāgatabālastrīhiṃsakān saṃvasen na tu /
cīrṇavratān api sataḥ kṛtaghnasahitān imān //
meaning:
शरणागतबालस्त्रीहिंसकान् संवसेन् न तु /
चीर्णव्रतान् अपि सतः कृतघ्नसहितान् इमान् //
text_mt: One should never associate with killers of those who sought refuge, children, or women, / even when they have observed the vow, nor with ungrateful persons.

sanskrit_iast:
ghaṭe 'pavarjite jñātimadhyastho yavasaṃ gavām /
sa dadyāt prathamaṃ gobhiḥ satkṛtasya hi satkriyā //
meaning:
घटे ऽपवर्जिते ज्ञातिमध्यस्थो यवसं गवाम् /
स दद्यात् प्रथमं गोभिः सत्कृतस्य हि सत्क्रिया //
text_mt: When the jar has been discarded, he, standing among his relatives, should give fodder to cows / first; for an act of hospitality is due to one honoured by cows.

sanskrit_iast:
vikhyātadoṣaḥ kurvīta parṣado 'numataṃ vratam /
anabhikhyātadoṣas tu rahasyaṃ vratam ācaret //
meaning:
विख्यातदोषः कुर्वीत पर्षदो ऽनुमतं व्रतम् /
अनभिख्यातदोषस् तु रहस्यं व्रतम् आचरेत् //
text_mt: One whose fault is widely known should perform a vow approved by the assembly; / but one whose fault is unknown should observe a secret vow.

sanskrit_iast:
trirātropoṣito japtvā brahmahā tv aghamarṣaṇam /
antarjale viśudhyeta dattvā gāṃ ca payasvinām //
meaning:
त्रिरात्रोपोषितो जप्त्वा ब्रह्महा त्व् अघमर्षणम् /
अन्तर्जले विशुध्येत दत्त्वा गां च पयस्विनाम् //
text_mt:
Having fasted for three nights and muttered the Aghamarṣaṇa hymn
under water, the slayer of a Brahmin becomes purified, and by giving a milch cow.

sanskrit_iast:
lomabhyaḥ svāhety atha vā divasaṃ mārutāśanaḥ /
jale sthitvābhijuhuyāc catvāriṃśadghṛtāhutīḥ //
meaning:
लोमभ्यः स्वाहेत्य् अथ वा दिवसं मारुताशनः /
जले स्थित्वाभिजुहुयाच् चत्वारिंशद्घृताहुतीः //
text_mt:
Or else, subsisting on air for a day, standing in water,
he should offer forty oblations of clarified butter with the words: 'To the bodily hairs, svāhā.'

sanskrit_iast:
trirātropoṣito hutvā kūṣmāṇḍībhir ghṛtaṃ śuciḥ /
brāhmaṇasvarṇahārī tu rudrajāpī jale sthitaḥ //
meaning:
त्रिरात्रोपोषितो हुत्वा कूष्माण्डीभिर् घृतं शुचिः /
ब्राह्मणस्वर्णहारी तु रुद्रजापी जले स्थितः //
text_mt:
Having fasted for three nights, offering clarified butter with the Kūṣmāṇḍa hymns, purified,
a stealer of a Brahmin's gold, muttering the Rudra hymns while standing in water, [becomes purified].

sanskrit_iast:
sahasraśīrṣājāpī tu mucyate gurutalpagaḥ /
gaur deyā karmaṇo 'syānte pṛthag ebhiḥ payasvinī //
meaning:
सहस्रशीर्षाजापी तु मुच्यते गुरुतल्पगः /
गौर् देया कर्मणो ऽस्यान्ते पृथग् एभिः पयस्विनी //
text_mt:
One who has violated his guru's bed is freed by muttering the hymn beginning with 'A thousand heads' [Puruṣasūkta];
at the end of this rite, a milch cow should be given separately by each of these.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇāyāmaśataṃ kāryaṃ sarvapāpāpanuttaye /
upapātakajātānām anādiṣṭasya caiva hi //
meaning:
प्राणायामशतं कार्यं सर्वपापापनुत्तये /
उपपातकजातानाम् अनादिष्टस्य चैव हि //
text_mt:
A hundred breath controls are to be performed for the removal of all sins,
of classes of minor sins, and also of any unspecified sin.

sanskrit_iast:
oṃkārābhiṣṭutaṃ somasalilaṃ pāvanaṃ pibet /
kṛtvā hi retoviṇmūtraprāśanaṃ tu dvijottamaḥ //
meaning:
ओंकाराभिष्टुतं सोमसलिलं पावनं पिबेत् /
कृत्वा हि रेतोविण्मूत्रप्राशनं तु द्विजोत्तमः //
text_mt:
Having ingested semen, feces, or urine,
a supreme twice-born should drink purifying Soma water consecrated with the sacred syllable Om.

sanskrit_iast:
niśāyāṃ vā divā vāpi yad ajñānakṛtaṃ bhavet /
traikālyasaṃdhyākaraṇāt tat sarvaṃ vipraṇaśyati //
meaning:
निशायां वा दिवा वापि यद् अज्ञानकृतं भवेत् /
त्रैकाल्यसंध्याकरणात् तत् सर्वं विप्रणश्यति //
text_mt:
Whatever may have been done in ignorance, whether at night or by day,
all of that is entirely destroyed by performing the twilight devotion at the three times of day.

sanskrit_iast:
śukriyāraṇyakajapo gāyatryāś ca viśeṣataḥ /
sarvapāpaharā hy ete rudraikādaśinī tathā //
meaning:
शुक्रियारण्यकजपो गायत्र्याश् च विशेषतः /
सर्वपापहरा ह्य् एते रुद्रैकादशिनी तथा //
text_mt:
The muttering of the Śukriya hymns, the Āraṇyaka, and especially the Gāyatrī,
and likewise the eleven Rudras—for these remove all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
yatra yatra ca saṃkīrṇam ātmānaṃ manyate dvijaḥ /
tatra tatra tilair homo gāyatryā vācanaṃ tathā //
meaning:
यत्र यत्र च संकीर्णम् आत्मानं मन्यते द्विजः /
तत्र तत्र तिलैर् होमो गायत्र्या वाचनं तथा //
text_mt:
And wherever a twice-born considers himself defiled,
there an oblation with sesame seeds and recitation of the Gāyatrī [should be performed].

sanskrit_iast:
vedābhyāsarataṃ kṣāntaṃ pañcayajñakriyāparam /
na spṛśantīha pāpāni mahāpātakajāny api //
meaning:
वेदाभ्यासरतं क्षान्तं पञ्चयज्ञक्रियापरम् /
न स्पृशन्तीह पापानि महापातकजान्य् अपि //
text_mt:
Sins, even those arising from mortal sins,
do not touch in this world one devoted to the study of the Veda, patient, and intent on the rites of the five great sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
vāyubhakṣo divā tiṣṭhan rātriṃ nītvāpsu sūryadṛk /
japtvā sahasraṃ gāyatryāḥ śudhyed brahmavadhād ṛte //
meaning:
वायुभक्षो दिवा तिष्ठन् रात्रिं नीत्वाप्सु सूर्यदृक् /
जप्त्वा सहस्रं गायत्र्याः शुध्येद् ब्रह्मवधाद् ऋते //
text_mt:
Subsisting on air, standing by day, spending the night in water, gazing at the sun,
having muttered a thousand Gāyatrīs, one is purified, except from the slaying of a Brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmacaryaṃ dayā kṣāntir dānaṃ satyam akalkatā /
ahiṃsā steyamādhurye damaś ceti yamāḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मचर्यं दया क्षान्तिर् दानं सत्यम् अकल्कता /
अहिंसा स्तेयमाधुर्ये दमश् चेति यमाः स्मृताः //
text_mt:
Celibate studenthood, compassion, patience, generosity, truthfulness, integrity,
non-violence, non-stealing, gentleness, and self-restraint are recorded as the restraints.

sanskrit_iast:
snānaṃ maunopavāsejyāsvādhyāyopasthanigrahāḥ /
niyamā guruśuśrūṣā śaucākrodhāpramādatā //
meaning:
स्नानं मौनोपवासेज्यास्वाध्यायोपस्थनिग्रहाः /
नियमा गुरुशुश्रूषा शौचाक्रोधाप्रमादता //
text_mt:
Bathing, silence, fasting, worship, recitation of the Veda, restraint of the sexual organs,
service to the guru, purification, absence of anger, and vigilance are the observances.

sanskrit_iast:
gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśodakam /
jagdhvā pare 'hny upavaset kṛcchraṃ sāntapanaṃ caret //
meaning:
गोमूत्रं गोमयं क्षीरं दधि सर्पिः कुशोदकम् /
जग्ध्वा परे ऽह्न्य् उपवसेत् कृच्छ्रं सान्तपनं चरेत् //
text_mt:
Having consumed cow's urine, cow dung, milk, curd, clarified butter, and water with kuśa grass,
one should fast on the next day; one should perform the Sāntapana kṛcchra.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthaksāntapanadravyaiḥ ṣaḍahaḥ sopavāsakaḥ /
saptāhena tu kṛcchro 'yaṃ mahāsāntapanaḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
पृथक्सान्तपनद्रव्यैः षडहः सोपवासकः /
सप्ताहेन तु कृच्छ्रो ऽयं महासान्तपनः स्मृतः //
text_mt:
[Subsisting] on the individual substances of the Sāntapana for six days, accompanied by a fast [on the seventh],
this kṛcchra of seven days is recorded as the Mahāsāntapana.

sanskrit_iast:
parṇodumbararājīvabilvapatrakuśodakaiḥ /
pratyekaṃ pratyahaṃ pītaiḥ parṇakṛcchra udāhṛtaḥ //
meaning:
पर्णोदुम्बरराजीवबिल्वपत्रकुशोदकैः /
प्रत्येकं प्रत्यहं पीतैः पर्णकृच्छ्र उदाहृतः //
text_mt:
By drinking [the decoction of] leaves, udumbara, lotus, bilva leaves, and kuśa water,
each individually on each day, it is declared to be the Parṇakṛcchra.

sanskrit_iast:
taptakṣīraghṛtāmbūnām ekaikaṃ pratyahaṃ pibet /
ekarātropavāsaś ca taptakṛcchra udāhṛtaḥ //
meaning:
तप्तक्षीरघृताम्बूनाम् एकैकं प्रत्यहं पिबेत् /
एकरात्रोपवासश् च तप्तकृच्छ्र उदाहृतः //
text_mt:
One should drink hot milk, hot clarified butter, and hot water, each on one day,
and fast for one night; it is declared to be the Taptakṛcchra.

sanskrit_iast:
ekabhaktena naktena tathaivāyācitena ca /
upavāsena caivāyaṃ pādakṛcchraḥ prakīrtitaḥ //
meaning:
एकभक्तेन नक्तेन तथैवायाचितेन च /
उपवासेन चैवायं पादकृच्छ्रः प्रकीर्तितः //
text_mt:
With one meal by day, [one] by night, [one meal] unasked for,
and a fast [on the fourth day], this is proclaimed to be the Pādakṛcchra.

sanskrit_iast:
yathākathaṃcit triguṇaḥ prājāpatyo 'yam ucyate /
ayam evātikṛcchraḥ syāt pāṇipūrānnabhojanaḥ //
meaning:
यथाकथंचित् त्रिगुणः प्राजापत्यो ऽयम् उच्यते /
अयम् एवातिकृच्छ्रः स्यात् पाणिपूरान्नभोजनः //
text_mt:
Repeated three times in any manner, this is called the Prājāpatya penance;
this very [penance], when eating food filling [only] the hand, would be the severe kṛcchra penance.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛcchrātikṛcchraḥ payasā divasānekaviṃśatim /
dvādaśāhopavāsena parākaḥ parikīrtitaḥ //
meaning:
कृच्छ्रातिकृच्छ्रः पयसा दिवसानेकविंशतिम् /
द्वादशाहोपवासेन पराकः परिकीर्तितः //
text_mt:
The most severe kṛcchra penance is [performed] with milk for twenty-one days;
the Parāka fast is proclaimed to be a fast of twelve days.

sanskrit_iast:
piṇyākācāmatakrāmbusaktūnāṃ prativāsaram /
ekarātropavāsaś ca kṛcchraḥ saumyo 'yam ucyate //
meaning:
पिण्याकाचामतक्राम्बुसक्तूनां प्रतिवासरम् /
एकरात्रोपवासश् च कृच्छ्रः सौम्यो ऽयम् उच्यते //
text_mt:
[Subsisting on] oil-cake, scum of boiled rice, buttermilk, water, and barley-meal, each on a day,
and a fast for one night, this is called the Saumya kṛcchra.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣāṃ trirātram abhyāsād ekaikasya yathākramam /
tulāpuruṣa ity eṣa jñeyaḥ pañcadaśāhikaḥ //
meaning:
एषां त्रिरात्रम् अभ्यासाद् एकैकस्य यथाक्रमम् /
तुलापुरुष इत्य् एष ज्ञेयः पञ्चदशाहिकः //
text_mt:
From the repetition of each of these for three nights in due order,
this balance-ordeal penance of fifteen days is to be known.

sanskrit_iast:
tithivṛddhyā caret piṇḍān śukle śikhyaṇḍasammitān /
ekaikaṃ hrāsayet kṛṣne piṇḍaṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ caran //
meaning:
तिथिवृद्ध्या चरेत् पिण्डान् शुक्ले शिख्यण्डसम्मितान् /
एकैकं ह्रासयेत् कृष्ने पिण्डं चान्द्रायणं चरन् //
text_mt:
Performing the lunar penance, one should consume morsels sized like a peahen's egg with the increase of lunar days in the bright [fortnight],
and decrease the morsel by one each day in the dark [fortnight].

sanskrit_iast:
yathākathaṃcit piṇḍānāṃ catvāriṃśac chatadvayam /
māsenaivopabhuñjīta cāndrāyaṇam athāparam //
meaning:
यथाकथंचित् पिण्डानां चत्वारिंशच् छतद्वयम् /
मासेनैवोपभुञ्जीत चान्द्रायणम् अथापरम् //
text_mt:
Alternatively, one should consume two hundred and forty morsels in any manner whatsoever
in the course of a month; [this is] another lunar penance.

sanskrit_iast:
kuryāt triṣavaṇasnāyī kṛcchraṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ tathā /
pavitrāṇi japet piṇḍān gāyatryā cābhimantrayet //
meaning:
कुर्यात् त्रिषवणस्नायी कृच्छ्रं चान्द्रायणं तथा /
पवित्राणि जपेत् पिण्डान् गायत्र्या चाभिमन्त्रयेत् //
text_mt:
Bathing at the three daily junctures, one should perform the kṛcchra and likewise the lunar penance;
one should mutter purifying texts and consecrate the morsels with the Gāyatrī.

sanskrit_iast:
anādiṣṭeṣu pāpeṣu śuddhiś cāndrāyaṇena ca /
dharmārthaṃ yaś cared etac candrasyaiti salokatām //
meaning:
अनादिष्टेषु पापेषु शुद्धिश् चान्द्रायणेन च /
धर्मार्थं यश् चरेद् एतच् चन्द्रस्यैति सलोकताम् //
text_mt:
And in the case of unspecified sins, purification is by the lunar penance;
whoever performs this for the sake of duty attains the same world as the Moon.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛcchrakṛd dharmakāmas tu mahatīṃ śriyam āpnuyāt /
yathā gurukratuphalaṃ prāpnoti susamāhitaḥ //
meaning:
कृच्छ्रकृद् धर्मकामस् तु महतीं श्रियम् आप्नुयात् /
यथा गुरुक्रतुफलं प्राप्नोति सुसमाहितः //
text_mt:
One who performs a kṛcchra desiring duty obtains great prosperity;
well-concentrated, he attains the fruit like that of a great sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvaitān ṛṣayo dharmān yājñavalkyena bhāṣitān /
idam ūcur mahātmānaṃ yogīndram amitaujasam //
meaning:
श्रुत्वैतान् ऋषयो धर्मान् याज्ञवल्क्येन भाषितान् /
इदम् ऊचुर् महात्मानं योगीन्द्रम् अमितौजसम् //
text_mt:
Having heard these duties spoken by Yājñavalkya,
the seers addressed this to that great soul, the lord of yogins of boundless splendour:

sanskrit_iast:
ya idaṃ dhārayiṣyanti dharmaśāstram atandritāḥ /
iha loke yaśaḥ prāpya te yāsyanti triviṣṭapam //
meaning:
य इदं धारयिष्यन्ति धर्मशास्त्रम् अतन्द्रिताः /
इह लोके यशः प्राप्य ते यास्यन्ति त्रिविष्टपम् //
text_mt:
'Those who will maintain this treatise on duty without negligence,
having attained fame in this world, shall go to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
vidyārthī prāpnuyād vidyāṃ dhanakāmo dhanaṃ tathā /
āyuṣkāmas tathaivāyuḥ śrīkāmo mahatīṃ śriyam //
meaning:
विद्यार्थी प्राप्नुयाद् विद्यां धनकामो धनं तथा /
आयुष्कामस् तथैवायुः श्रीकामो महतीं श्रियम् //
text_mt:
One desiring knowledge would attain knowledge, one desiring wealth likewise wealth,
one desiring long life likewise long life, and one desiring prosperity great prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
ślokatrayam api hy asmād yaḥ śrāddhe śrāvayiṣyati /
pitṝṇāṃ tasya tṛptiḥ syād akṣayyā nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
श्लोकत्रयम् अपि ह्य् अस्माद् यः श्राद्धे श्रावयिष्यति /
पितॄणां तस्य तृप्तिः स्याद् अक्षय्या नात्र संशयः //
text_mt:
Whoever recites even three verses from this during an ancestral rite,
of his ancestors there will be imperishable satisfaction; there is no doubt here.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇaḥ pātratāṃ yāti kṣatriyo vijayī bhavet /
vaiśyaś ca dhānyadhanavān asya śāstrasya dhāraṇāt //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणः पात्रतां याति क्षत्रियो विजयी भवेत् /
वैश्यश् च धान्यधनवान् अस्य शास्त्रस्य धारणात् //
text_mt:
A Brahmin attains worthy standing, a Kshatriya becomes victorious,
and a Vaishya becomes rich in grain and wealth through maintaining this treatise.

sanskrit_iast:
ya idaṃ śrāvayed vidvān dvijān parvasu parvasu /
aśvamedhaphalaṃ tasya tad bhavān anumanyatām //
meaning:
य इदं श्रावयेद् विद्वान् द्विजान् पर्वसु पर्वसु /
अश्वमेधफलं तस्य तद् भवान् अनुमन्यताम् //
text_mt:
Whatever wise man would recite this to twice-borns on every lunar juncture,
his is the fruit of a horse sacrifice; may your honour assent to that!'

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvaitad yājñavaklyo 'pi prītātmā munibhāṣitam /
evam astv iti hovāca namaskṛtya svayaṃbhuve //
meaning:
श्रुत्वैतद् याज्ञवक्ल्यो ऽपि प्रीतात्मा मुनिभाषितम् /
एवम् अस्त्व् इति होवाच नमस्कृत्य स्वयंभुवे //
text_mt:
Having heard this spoken by the sages, Yājñavalkya too, pleased in spirit,
having bowed to the Self-existent [Brahmā], said: 'Let it be so!'
